desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A1_1}Tubilis lies on the Bay of Charas, which the Aserai call Shariz. Villagers go fishing here amid the offshore islands in search of tuna, sardines, and shark.
desc_cn: 突比力斯位于沙拉斯湾，阿塞莱人亦称此地为沙瑞兹。村民们会驾船前往岛屿间的浅滩，寻找并捕捞金枪鱼、沙丁鱼和鲨鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A1_3}Fanab sits in a low promontory between the bay that the Aserai call the Gulf of Shariz and the inner sea of the Bahr al-Yeshm.  The seawinds bring just enough rain to support the cultivation of olive trees.
desc_cn: 法纳卜坐落于阿塞莱人称作沙瑞兹的海湾与耶什姆内海间的一个低矮的海角上。海风带来的雨水刚好够用来种些橄榄树。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A2_1}Sahel on the far edges of the Aserai lands, on the low-lying Jabal Ashabi mountains. This ridge catches rainclouds coming off the Bahr al-Yeshm sea and are brushed by monsoons from the southeast, allowing cistern-watered fields of millet and wheat.
desc_cn: 萨赫勒位于阿塞莱领土的边陲，坐落在低矮的阿沙卜山脉上。山脉留住了来自耶什姆海的雨云，和自东南方向吹来的季风，使得当地的贮水农田可种植栗子和小麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A2_2}Asmait lies in a nook of the Jabal Ashabi mountains, bordered to the south by the deep desert. Villagers trap floods running down the hills during rare rainstorms, using the water to grow date palms and other crops.
desc_cn: 阿斯麦特位于阿沙卜山脉的角落，南边毗邻沙漠深处。村民们会在罕见的暴雨天截住山上的洪流，利用这些水种植椰枣树及其他作物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A3_1}Ain Baliq is clustered around a well in a wide valley that separates the Jarjara Escarpment from the Jabal Tamar mountains to the west. The surrounding lands, though dry, produce enough grass in the spring to allow the breeding of horses.
desc_cn: 艾因·巴力克的村民围绕着一口开阔山谷内的水井繁衍生息，这道山谷将杰尔贾赖峭壁从塔玛尔山的西面分割开来。其周围的土地尽管干旱，但在春季仍可长出足以繁育马匹的牧草。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A3_2}Deir Hawa sits on the windswept southern shores of the sea that the Aserai call the Bahr al-Yeshm. It survives on pit-mining in the dry nearby hills for silver. Although centuries of exploitation have long exhausted the richest veins, the villagers practice a number of close-guarded techniques to extract the precious metal from ore.
desc_cn: 代尔·哈瓦坐落于阿塞莱人所说的耶什姆海的当风南岸。村民们依靠在附近干燥的山丘上开采露天银矿维持生计。尽管几个世纪的开采早已耗尽了最丰富的矿脉，但村民们仍采用一些秘而不宣的技术，从矿石中提取贵金属。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A4_1}Medeni sits in lowlands between the Bahr al-Yeshm sea and the Jarjara Escarpment. Villagers grow dates by the coast in gardens watered by wells and small dams in the wadis that trap run-off from the cliffs during the short rainy season.
desc_cn: 迈代尼坐落于耶什姆海与杰尔贾赖峭壁之间的低地。村民们通过水井和旱谷的小堤坝，来在短暂的雨季获取山崖流下的地表水，用以灌溉岸边的椰枣园。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A4_2}Qidnar lies in the floodplain of the Damar river, the most densely populated part of the Aserai lands, where it slices through the Jarjara Escarpment. Farmers here grow date orchards in the rich silt brought by the river's annual flooding.
desc_cn: 吉德纳尔坐落于达玛尔河的河漫滩，该地穿过杰尔贾赖峭壁，是阿塞莱人口最稠密的地方。当地农民依靠河水每年周期性泛滥带来的淤泥种植椰枣。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A5_1}Jamayeh sits on the southern shores of the sea that the Aserai call the Bahr al Yeshm, the Jade Sea. The climate is well-suited to olive trees that thrive despite the short rainy season.
desc_cn: 贾迈耶位于阿塞莱人所说的“拜赫尔·耶什姆”，即“翡翠之海”的南岸。当地虽然雨季短暂，但气候很适合橄榄树生长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A3_2}Hunab lies in one of the wadis that cut beneath the weathered mesas of the Jarjara Escarpment. Villagers raise horses here, taking advantage of the brief but lush crop of grass that covers the slopes in the spring.
desc_cn: 侯纳卜坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁风化台地下的一座干谷中。当地村民们利用春天覆盖山坡的短暂而繁茂的青草来饲养马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A6_1}Shibal Zumr sits on the Nahr al-Kals, the river of lime. Here the waters are pure and the soil is fertile, and grain is grown. But a short distance to the south, the land becomes barren and alkaline, and only the hardiest crops survive.
desc_cn: 希巴勒·祖姆尔位于“奈赫尔·凯勒斯”，即石灰河之畔。此处水清土沃，可种植谷物。但再往南不远，就是贫瘠的盐碱地，只能种些特别好养活的庄稼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A2_1}Lamesa sits amid open plains and patches of dry acacia forest on the eastern shores of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Some of the Aserai's most prized horses graze on the grasses of this district.
desc_cn: 拉迈萨位于耶什姆海东岸的开阔平原处，附近有稀疏的金合欢树林。阿塞莱最好的一些马儿就在该地区吃草。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A7_1}Uqba sits alongside the Perassic Sea. Villagers trap rainwater and runoff from the hills to water their fields and their gardens of date-palms.
desc_cn: 但再次假设你是执政官加里俄斯，正谋划称帝。你需要与苏丹缔结条约，宜早不宜迟。而苏丹的朝廷里满是心怀不甘的商人。因此，你宣布了一份将被流放的人员名单，都是些才智胆识兼备之人，闻名于整个珀拉斯海。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A7_2}Bunqaz sits at the mouth of the great wadi that divides the Jarjara Escarpment from the Jabal Tamar hills. Villagers sink wells here to tap the wadi's groundwater, using it to irrigate their olive groves.
desc_cn: 本盖兹坐落于分割杰尔贾赖峭壁与塔玛尔山的大旱谷的入口处。村民们通过打井来获取旱谷的地下水，用来灌溉橄榄林。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A8_1}Tamnuh sits near a large lagoon, cut off from the Perassic Sea by a sandspit. Villagers scrape clay from the shallow waters to sell to the region's potters.
desc_cn: 坦姆努坐落于珀拉斯海被沙嘴分割出的大潟湖边。村民们刮取浅水区的黏土，卖给当地的陶工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A4_3}Kuqa sits at the foot of a range of low hills east of the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, where the Aserai deserts give way to desert-steppe with scattered acacia and scrub. The villagers here sink wells to water their groves of date palms.
desc_cn: 库加坐落在耶什姆海以东的小山丘脚下，在这里阿塞莱沙漠让位于散布着金合欢树和灌木丛的荒漠草原。当地村民们打水井来浇灌椰枣树林。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_A9_1}The oasis-village of Barihal sits in a wadi amid the mesas of the Jarjara Escarpment. The land is best known for the horses that are grazed on the desert's short-lived but rich spring grasses.
desc_cn: 巴里哈勒绿洲村位于杰尔贾赖峭壁台地中的旱谷边。当地最出名的是用短命而肥美的春草饲养的马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A7_1}Wadar sits in the rocky wadis at the inland edge of the Jarjara Escarpment, before it gives way to barren gravel plains and dunes. Clouds from the Bahr al-Yeshm drop their last reserves of water here in the spring and winter, giving the land just enough grass to support horse-rearing.
desc_cn: 瓦达尔坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁向陆侧岩石嶙嶙的干河谷中，距这里不远处就是贫瘠的沙砾平原与沙丘。春冬之时，来自耶什姆海的云会在这里降下最后一些水，为当地养马业滋养出刚好足够的草地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B1_1}Ab Comer sits on the steep pass cut by the upper Trand river that climbs the Uchalion plateau. The tribes of this region grow grapes on the hillsides, used to make a white wine popular with the imperial and Vlandian aristocracies.
desc_cn: 阿布·科梅尔坐落于穿过乌卡利翁高原的特朗河上游的陡峭处。当地各部落会在山坡上种植葡萄，用以酿造一种深受帝国与瓦兰迪亚贵族欢迎的白葡萄酒。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B5_4}Inveth sits where the rivers Trand and Etir come tumbling out of the Uchalion massif, join together, and flow into the plains of central Vlandia. The surrounding hillsides support the growing of wheat.
desc_cn: 因韦斯位于特朗河与埃蒂尔河从乌卡利翁地块翻滚而出处，这两条河汇合流入瓦兰迪亚中央的平原。该地周围环绕的丘陵适合种植小麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B2_1}Llanoc Hen sits in a ridge in the heights of the Uchalion massif. The villagers, known as skilled pig-farmers, look down two passes, the western one leading up from Vlandian lands and the eastern one leading up from the Empire.
desc_cn: 拉诺克·亨位于乌卡利翁地块的高山山脊处。村民们都是熟练的养猪户，他们下山后有两条路，一条向西通往瓦兰迪亚，另一条向东通往帝国。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B2_2}Cantrec sits in the rocky Glen of Balasog that climbs up from the imperial lands into the plateau of the Uchafion. The lands is not especially fertile here, but pigs thrive in the bush and shrubland of the heights.
desc_cn: 坎特雷克坐落于帝国领土通往乌喀利昂高原处多岩的巴拉索格峡谷之中。当地土壤并不十分肥沃，但高处的灌木林地很适合养猪。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B3_1}Druimmor sits in the Morcomb, a rift valley that divides the Uchalion plateau from the mountains of the Ebor peninsula. Miners here have found silver in clefts in the hillsides.
desc_cn: 德鲁伊莫尔坐落于摩康谷——一道分割乌卡利翁高原与埃博半岛的裂谷之中。矿工在当地的山边裂缝处发现了银矿。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B3_4}Tor Melina sits in a marshy basin in the dark forested hills of the northwestern Uchalion massif. Villagers take clay from the damp soil for sale to the potters of nearby towns.
desc_cn: 托·梅利纳坐落于乌卡利翁地块西北部阴暗林丘内的一块沼泽盆地中。村民们从潮湿的泥土中提取黏土，卖给附近城镇的陶工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B4_1}Pendraic sits on the steep northern slope of the Uchalion, facing the Bay of Varcheg. It is a land of cold winds and constant low-level warfare, cris-crossed by Vlandian, Battanian and Sturgian raiding parties. The villagers raise hogs here, always listening to the warning horns telling them to drive their herds to hiding spots in the hills.
desc_cn: 潘德拉克坐落在乌卡利翁北部的陡坡上，面对着瓦尔切格湾。该地频繁受到冷风与瓦兰迪亚、巴旦尼亚、斯特吉亚劫掠队的侵袭，小规模战斗时有发生。养猪的村民们一听到警戒号角声，就把畜群赶进山中的藏身处。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B2_5}Lindorn sits on the green hills north and west of Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. The surrounding farmlands are sown with wheat and barley.
desc_cn: 林杜恩坐落于“林·泰瓦尔”——即暗湖的西北面绿色山丘上。周围的农田里种植着小麦和大麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B5_1}Rhemtoil lies beneath a cleft in the eastern escarpment of the Uchalion plateau, near the source of the river Miron, which the Battanians call the Myr. This is among the most fertile of the Battanian lands, and produces a fine crop of wheat.
desc_cn: 雷姆托伊尔位于乌卡利翁高原东部悬崖的裂隙下，靠近巴旦尼亚人称为“米尔”的弥戎河的源头。这里是巴旦尼亚土壤最肥沃的地方，小麦收成很好。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B5_2}Claig Ban lies at the foot of a steep cleft that climbs the Uchalion massif. The villagers here gather clay from the nearby Myr river for sale to the potters of the Battanian towns.
desc_cn: 克莱格·班坐落于乌卡利翁地块的一堵悬崖下。村民们从旁边的米尔河中收集黏土，卖给巴旦尼亚各城镇的陶工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B6_1}Flintolg sits on a high crest on the eastern side of the Uchalion massif. The soil is poor but the woods grow thick here, making this the source of much of the timber used in the Battanian lands.
desc_cn: 弗林托格坐落于乌卡利翁地块东部的高山山顶处。当地土壤贫瘠，但树木生得粗壮，使得这里成为巴旦尼亚的木材主要产地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B6_2}Glintor sits overlooking the rapids of the Fiur river, where the waters of Llyn Tywal descend to enter the Bay of Varcheg. Horses are raised on the downs, much prized by both raiders and traders from the Sturgian lands to the north.
desc_cn: 格林托尔俯瞰着湍急的费尔河，来自泰瓦尔湖的水流由此汇入瓦尔切格湾。当地草甸养出的马匹备受北方斯特吉亚强盗与商贩们的喜爱。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B7_1}Aster sits in a shallow valley between the hills of the northeastern Uchalion and the Rock of Glanys. The people of this region have the reputation of being more focused on trade than warfare, and tribal elders have encouraged the planting of vineyards to produce a particularly strong vintage of wine.
desc_cn: 阿斯特坐落于乌卡利翁东北部山丘和格兰尼斯山间的浅谷中。当地人比起打仗更关注贸易，部落长老们鼓励大家种植葡萄以酿造出特别醇厚的葡萄酒。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B2_4}Imlagh lies on rolling downs in the middle of the Uchalion massif. The village specializes in white grapes for the making of the sweet Battanian wines.
desc_cn: 伊姆拉赫位于乌卡利翁地块中部起伏的丘陵上。这座村庄特产用来酿造巴旦尼亚甜葡萄酒的白葡萄。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_B8_1}Uthelaim sits on the eastern frontiers of the Battanian lands on a ridge overlooking a tributary of the Myr. The people of these parts are foresters, felling the oak, yew and pine of the woods for sale to builders and shipwrights.
desc_cn: 乌瑟莱姆位于巴旦尼亚东部边境的一座山脊上，俯瞰着米尔河的一条支流。当地人是林农，他们采伐橡树、紫杉和松树，并将木材卖给建筑工和造船工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B4_5}Seordas sits in the lowlands at the eastern edge of the Battanian lands, at the foot of the Uchalion escarpment. The nearby fortress of Uthelaim shields the district's exposed farms from Sturgian raiders coming from the east.
desc_cn: 肖尔达斯坐落于巴旦尼亚东部边境的低地，在乌卡利翁山崖脚下。附近的乌瑟莱姆要塞保护着该地暴露在外的农场，使其免受东边斯特吉亚强盗的袭击。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN1_1}Varagos sits on the Aris river, a small highland stream that flows into the deep pool known as the Ophthys. The land here is not especially rich, but is sufficient for the raising of sheep.
desc_cn: 瓦拉戈斯坐落在阿里斯河畔，来自高地的细小河流由此汇入深邃的俄佛堤斯湖。当地土壤并不十分肥沃，但足够饲养绵羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN3_2}Aeoria sits in the fertile Vale of the Aris, in the heartland of the Empire. The dialect here is laced with words from Palaic, the language spoken in the center of the continent before the Empire came.
desc_cn: 艾俄里亚位于帝国腹地土壤肥沃的阿里斯谷。当地方言掺杂了帕拉语词汇，帝国人到来前大陆中央居民说的是帕拉语。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN2_1}Lochana sits on the eastern shore of Lake Laconis. The lake tempers the cold of the northern winters here, allowing the cultivation of mulberry bushes for silk.
desc_cn: 罗卡那位于拉科尼斯湖的东岸。拉科尼斯湖缓和了北方冬季的寒冷，为种植桑树、产蚕丝提供了条件。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN4_3}Nortanisa is a fishing village on the southern shores of Lake Laconis. Villagers place nets and cages in the shallow edges of the lake to catch roach, bream, perch, and crayfish.
desc_cn: 诺耳塔尼萨是拉科尼斯湖南岸的一座渔村。村民们在湖泊的浅滩放置渔网和渔笼，来捕获拟鲤、鲷鱼、鲈鱼和小龙虾。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN3_1}Rhesos sits in a plateau in the Dryatic mountains. Highland cattle thrive on the grasses of the heights.
desc_cn: 雷索斯位于德律亚山脉的一片高原上。高原牛靠着这里的高地牧草茁壮成长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN1_4}Dyopalis lies in a valley in the Dryatic mountains. Despite the cold winters, the region's fertile soils make this district one of the breadbaskets of the northern Empire.
desc_cn: 底俄帕利斯位于德律亚山脉的一座山谷中。尽管冬季寒冷，但该地肥沃的土壤使其成为了北帝国重要的“粮仓”之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN4_1}Gaos sits in a broad valley in the Myzead, the hill country in the east of the empire. Nomadic herders once occupied this land, and the village's name is taken from their word for cattle.
desc_cn: 伽俄斯位于帝国东边的丘陵地——密泽亚德的宽阔山谷中。游牧民族曾占据此地，村庄就得名于他们语言中“牛”的叫法。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN5_3}Themys lies under a ridge of limestone crags in the Myzead, the hill country of the imperial heartland. The grasses on the rolling downs are well-suited to the raising of sheep.
desc_cn: 忒密斯位于帝国腹地的山区——密泽亚德的石灰岩峭壁之下。当地丘陵上生长的草非常适合养羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN5_1}Atrion in the valley of the Nevys, a cold, slow-moving river that drains into Lake Laconis. The land here is suitable for the cultivation of mulberry bushes, used to produce silk.
desc_cn: 阿特里翁坐落于涅维斯谷中，冰冷的缓流由此汇入拉科尼斯湖。这里的土地适合种植桑树，用于生产蚕丝。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN2_3}Masangara sits on the banks of the Nevys, a cold, slow-moving river that empties into Lake Laconis. Cattle are raised here in former marshy woodlands, now drained and turned into meadows.
desc_cn: 马珊加拉坐落于涅维斯河岸，这条冰冷的河缓缓流入拉科尼斯湖。这里曾经是一片沼地树林，现在人们把水排干，将其变为牧牛地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN6_1}Ataconia sits on a plateau in the piedmont of the Dryatic mountains. The streams rushing down from the mountains have exposed deposits of salt in the hillsides, which are mined by the local population.
desc_cn: 阿塔科尼亚坐落于德律亚山脉前的一片高原上。从山上奔流而下的溪流冲刷出山坡上的盐矿沉积，当地居民便对这些盐矿进行开采。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN4_1}Potamis sits in a valley in the lower Dryatic mountains. The people of these parts have raised cattle since pre-Calradic times, and its milk and butter are sought out by traders and travellers passing through the region.
desc_cn: 珀塔米斯坐落在德律亚山脉的一处低谷中。这里的人们自前卡拉德时代就开始养牛了，经过该地区的商贩和旅行者们很容易买到牛奶和黄油。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN7_1}Epinosa lies in the far north of the Empire, just south of the glacial lakes known as the Iltan portages, where ships are hauled between Lakes Laconis and Tanaesis. The region is relatively thinly populated, but large herds of cattle graze on the green downs.
desc_cn: 厄毗诺萨位于帝国的极北之地，刚好在伊勒坦运输线的冰川湖南岸，拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间的船只川流不息。该地区人口相对稀少，但葱郁的草甸上放养着大群的牛。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN7_2}Pons is one of the northernmost settlements of the Empire. It is named for the 'crossing' of the Iltan portages, a network of glacial lakes that allow ships to be hauled between Lakes Laconis and Tanaesis. The locals mine deposits of salt in the nearby hills.
desc_cn: 庞斯是帝国最北端的定居点之一。该地因位于伊勒坦运输线的“交叉口”而得名，一系列冰川湖构成的网络令船只得以通行于拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间。当地人在附近的山丘上开采盐矿。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN8_1}Syratos sits at the base of an escarpment just north of Lake Tanaesis. Flax grows well here, in the cold damp valley floor.
desc_cn: 叙拉托斯坐落于塔奈西斯湖北岸的一处峭壁之上。在这寒冷潮湿的谷底，亚麻生长得很好。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN8_2}Tememos lies in heavily wooded hill country at the northern end of Lake Tanaesis. Many of the villagers work as foresters, harvesting oak, beech and pine for the sale to the lake cities.
desc_cn: 特美摩斯坐落于塔奈西斯湖北端树木繁茂的丘陵地。当地许多村民都是林农，他们采伐橡树、山毛榉和松树并销往湖边的城镇。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN9_1}Mecalovea sits overlooking the Galchasic Cataracts, a series of rapids and waterfalls through which the Miron river empties into Lake Laconis. The village, perched on a cliffside for protection from raiders in this frontier region, thrives on the ore deposits exposed where the cataract cuts through the escaparment.
desc_cn: 墨卡罗维亚俯瞰着伽尔喀斯大瀑布，这座瀑布由一系列湍急的水流构成，并最终同弥戎河一起汇入拉科尼斯湖。村庄座落于一道峭壁之上，以期在这边疆之地免受强盗匪帮的侵扰。飞流直下的瀑布拍过峭壁，将许多矿石暴露出来，村民就以此为生。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EN9_2}Agalmon sits near the juncture of the Galcha and the Miron, two small but fast-flowing northern rivers. This foresting village has had mostly good relations with its Sturgian neighbors thanks to decades of intermarriage, though they have become strained of late with the outbreak of war.
desc_cn: 阿加尔蒙紧挨着两条细小而湍急的北方河流——伽尔喀斯河和弥戎河的汇流处。这座多林村庄的居民世代与相邻的斯特吉亚人通婚，原本往来颇为友好，然而战争的爆发令双方关系趋于紧张。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES1_1}Odrysa lies on the far eastern frontiers of the Empire, just across the River Tiagys from lands that are now the Khuzait Khanate. Though this area is dry, oak and other trees grow in the Tiagys gorges and other nooks in the hills, sustaining a small lumber industry.
desc_cn: 俄德律萨坐落于帝国遥远的东部边境，蒂亚具斯河对岸就是如今库赛特汗国的领土。尽管当地气候干旱，但橡树等树木仍生长于蒂亚具斯峡谷和其他山谷的角落，为小规模的木材业提供原料。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES1_1}Caira sits amid the network of rivers, lakes and lagoons known as the Calsea. Any further east, the land becomes alkaline and barren, but here the floodplains of the parallel Calsa and Tiagys rivers allow the growing of wheat.
desc_cn: 恺拉坐落于被称为卡勒萨的河流、湖泊、潟湖交织的网络中。再往东一点的地方，就是相当贫瘠的碱性土，但在这里，卡勒萨河和蒂亚具斯河共同塑造的冲积平原可以种植小麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES2_1}Corenia is one of the farthest flung villages of the empire to speak the Calradic tongue. It sits in the plains southeast of Lake Tanaesis in the shadow of the Akkan Hills, beyond which is spoken only Darshi and the languages of the steppe. Villagers grow grain here, keeping watch for raiders from across the frontiers.
desc_cn: 科雷尼亚是帝国境内最偏远的村庄之一，这里的人还说着卡拉德语。它位于塔奈西斯湖东南方的平原上，阿克坎丘陵附近。过了那座山，人们就只说达西语和草原民族的语言了。当地村民种植谷物，随时提防着犯边的掠袭者。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES2_2}Metachia is the lies on the southern shores of Lake Tanaesis in the frontier lands beyond River Tiagys. This imperial colony, established in more peaceful times, is a center for mulberry bushes used in silk production.
desc_cn: 墨塔基亚坐落于塔奈西斯湖南岸越过蒂亚具斯河的边境地带上。这个帝国殖民地建于和平时期，是丝织业所需的桑树种植中心。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES3_1}Melion in a narrow valley near the center of the Myzead, a rugged plateau in the east of the Empire. Villagers here cultivate mulberry bushes. The leaves are harvested and fed to silkworks, producing thread much valued by both refined imperial nobles for their courtwear and hard-riding nomads and frontiersmen, who wear it beneath their armor as an extra layer of protection against arrows.
desc_cn: 墨利翁在密泽亚德——帝国东部崎岖高原的中央附近的一道狭窄山谷里。当地村民种植桑树，收获的树叶喂给蚕，产出的丝线同时受到衣着朝服的优雅帝国贵族与戎马倥偬的牧民边民的珍爱。后者将丝绸衣物穿在铠甲下，作为对箭矢的一层额外防护。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES3_2}Sagolina sits at the foot of a narrow valley in the Myzead, a rugged plateau in eastern Calradia. The silver mined from nearby hills helps explain the effort and expense to which the Empire has gone in past centuries to conquer and defend these lands.
desc_cn: 萨戈利那坐落于密泽亚德——卡拉迪亚东部崎岖高原的一道狭窄山谷底。附近山上开采的银矿解释了帝国为何在过去的几世纪内耗费人力物力对此地加以征服与守卫。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES4_1}Lavenia is a fishing village on the northeastern shores of the Perassic Sea. The nearby castle guards one of the main passages over the network of lakes and salt lagoons known as the Calsea, one of the gateways to Aserai lands.
desc_cn: 拉文尼亚是珀拉斯海东北岸的一座渔村。附近的城堡守卫着通往阿塞莱领土的关口要道，这些由湖泊和咸水湖构成的交通网络被称为卡勒萨。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES4_2}Ethemisa sits on the river that the Aserai call the Nahr al-Kals, the Bitter River, and what imperial citizens call the Calsa. Here, the river has just descended from the coastal hills and has not yet reached the alkali plains of the southeast. The lands around produce a fine crop of grain.
desc_cn: 厄忒弥萨坐落于阿塞莱人口中的“奈赫尔·凯勒斯”，即苦河之畔，帝国居民称之为卡勒萨。此处的河流刚从海边山上流下，尚未到达东南方的盐碱平原。附近土地的小麦收成很好。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES5_1}Morenia sits overlooking the Sethys river, on a low pass leading over the hills to the valley of the Lycarea. Villagers collect clay from the riverbanks for the kilns of the imperial southlands.
desc_cn: 摩雷尼亚俯瞰着塞堤斯河，位于通往吕卡里亚谷的低矮入口处。村民们在河畔收集黏土，供应帝国南方的窑炉。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES2_1}The village of Atphynia sits near the mouth of the Sethys river, just before it splits into three to form the valley known as Tripotamia. Villagers here have laid out salt pans near where the Sethys estuary joins the Perassic sea.
desc_cn: 阿特费尼亚村靠近塞堤斯河口，再向下游河流随即分为三支，形成三河河谷。在塞堤斯河流入珀拉斯海的河口附近，村民们开出了盐田。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES6_1}Sestadaim sits on the western side of the great Ornian rock, an outcrop in the center of the Lycarea valley. Some say the vultures for which the rock is named once gathered here to feast on the bodies of those who died working the local salt mines.
desc_cn: 塞斯塔代姆坐落于奥尼石山——吕卡里亚谷中央出露的一块巨岩的西侧。有人说这座石山得名自聚集于此饱餐死尸的秃鹫，而那些人死前还在当地的盐矿场工作。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES6_3}Amycon lies in a series of small but sharp ridges between the Ornion Rock and the Aris valley. The people of this land are sheep herders, known for their dry, salty cheese flavored with cumin.
desc_cn: 阿密孔坐落于奥兰石山与阿里斯河谷之间一片逶迤嶙峋的山脊之上。当地居民是牧羊人，以制作加孜然的咸味干酪而闻名。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES7_1}Jogurys lies on the flat western shores of Lake Tanaesis. This land was originally inhabited by nomadic tribes and has come under cultivation only recently. Imperial colonists have made intensive efforts to grow mullberry bushes here to raise silkworms, a lucrative product in this region.
desc_cn: 约格律斯位于塔奈西斯湖平坦的西岸边。该地原本居住的是游牧部落，直到最近才开垦。帝国殖民者们付出了巨大的努力，在这里种桑养蚕，获得了高利润的产品。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES7_3}Eunalica sits on the western shores of Lake Tanaesis. This low-lying country is fine land for the growing of flax.
desc_cn: 优纳利卡坐落于塔奈西斯湖西岸。这片洼地是种植亚麻的好地方。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_ES8_1}Chanopsis sits near the headwaters of the Sethys river in the plateau region known as the Myzead. Wheat grows well on the sun-baked plains.
desc_cn: 卡诺普西斯依着密泽亚德高原上的塞堤斯河源头而建。小麦在这片阳光充足的平原上长势喜人。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES4_2}Popsia in a narrow canyon between the Ornian Rock and the valley of the Ophthys pool. Trees grow tall here in the cool shadows of the hills, and villagers harvest pines for sale as lumber.
desc_cn: 波普西亚坐落于奥尼石山与俄佛堤斯湖域之间窄窄的峡谷内。山间阴凉处的树木生得高大，村民们会砍伐松树并将木材卖出。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW1_1}Garontor gives its name to the promontory between the Gulf of Charas and the inland Perassic sea. Coastal meadows, where tall grasses tolerant of the ocean salt-spray thrive, support the rearing of fine horses.
desc_cn: 位于沙拉斯湾和珀拉斯内海间的海角以加隆托为名。沿海草甸茂盛，这些较高的草对海水盐质的耐受性不错，可用来饲养优良的马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW4_2}Lysia gives its name to the narrow strait where the Perassic Sea joins the western ocean. It lies just on the Perassic side of the straits, near broad beaches that allow the farming of salt.
desc_cn: 珀拉斯内海汇入西海所经过的那条狭长海峡便以吕西亚为名。它位于珀拉斯海的一侧，附近宽阔的海滩用于建设盐田。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW2_1}Thorios sits in the Aris valley in the heart of Calradia. River irrigation and the relatively warm inland climate ensure that the grain fields of this district, along with neighboring Bergum, feed much of the central empire.
desc_cn: 托里俄斯坐落于卡拉迪亚腹地的阿里斯河谷中。河水灌溉与相对温暖的内陆气候，确保了该地区与相邻的柏耳贡的小麦田高产，喂养了帝国中部的许多人。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW2_2}Bergum sits in the Aris valley in the heart of Calradia. River irrigation and the relatively warm inland climate ensure that the grain fields of this district, along with neighboring Thorios, feed much of the central empire.
desc_cn: 柏耳贡坐落于卡拉迪亚腹地的阿里斯河谷中。河水灌溉与相对温暖的内陆气候，确保了该地区与相邻的托里俄斯的小麦田高产，喂养了帝国中部的许多人。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW3_1}Onica lies on the northern shores of the Perassic sea. The hills of this district are terraced with vineyards, producing a dry wine popular throughout the empire.
desc_cn: 俄尼卡坐落于珀拉斯海北岸。该地区的山丘上遍布梯田葡萄园，出产的干型葡萄酒在帝国各地广受欢迎。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW2_1}Tarcutis sits on the shores of the Perassic sea. The sandy soil and morning mists, channeled by offshore islands, allows the growing of grapes overlooking the beaches.
desc_cn: 塔耳库提斯坐落于珀拉斯海岸。近海岛屿冲过来的沙壤和晨雾，让俯瞰沙滩的地方得以建起葡萄园。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW4_1}Thractorae sits on a small bay that feeds into the larger Gulf of Charas. These lands, stirred by hot winds from the south and watered by hillside springs, have been used by imperial landowners for the experimental growing of date palms.
desc_cn: 色雷刻托坐落于汇入沙拉斯湾的一片小海湾旁。此地受南方热风的吹拂和山泉的滋润，被帝国的地主们用来进行椰枣树的试验性种植。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW3_1}Gamardan sits at the head of a small bay that branches off the larger Gulf of Charas. Tuna gather to spawn just offshore, and the fishermen of the area corral the large fish with nets before hauling them on board with grappling hooks.
desc_cn: 伽玛耳丹位于一片小海湾的头端，那片小海湾则由更大的沙拉斯湾分出。金枪鱼在近海聚集产卵，当地渔民先用渔网将这群大鱼围住，再用钩具将其拖拽上船。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW5_1}Veron in the foothills of the Uchalion massif, near the headwaters of the Garys river. The hills above the town are lined with vineyards which thrive in the well-drained, sandy soil.
desc_cn: 维戎位于乌卡利翁地块的丘陵地带，靠近伽律斯河的源头处。小镇上方的山丘上种着葡萄，这些葡萄在排水良好的沙质土壤上茁壮成长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW5_2}Goleryn sits in the warm, oak-covered Epiric hills, near both the Vlandian and Battanian frontiers. Sheep-raising is a way of life in these parts, as is sheep-rustling.
desc_cn: 戈勒林坐落于温暖而橡树繁茂的埃皮尔山丘上，靠近瓦兰迪亚与巴旦尼亚的边境交界处。养羊在该地区算是一种生计，偷羊亦然。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW6_1}Hertogea lies in the shadow of Mount Erithrys, a huge basalt slab thrust up from the depths of the earth. Villagers grow olives on the slopes leading up the mountain, famous for their light, fragrant oil.
desc_cn: 赫托该亚位于拔地而起的玄武岩巨山——厄里特律斯山附近。村民在山坡上种植橄榄树，所产橄榄油以其清淡芬芳而闻名。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW1_3}Nideon sits on a low-lying meander of the Zeos river, in the shadow of the plutonic Mount Erithrys. Wine grapes grow on the gentle slopes rising up from the river valley.
desc_cn: 尼得翁坐落于深成岩构成的厄里特律斯山脚下，在泽俄斯河低洼的蜿蜒处。酿酒用的葡萄生长在河谷的缓坡上。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW7_1}Oristocorys sits on the Bay of Ortysia, part of the seaway between the western ocean and the Perassic Sea. Early morning sea-mists from the west and the hot sun of midday allow the growing of wine grapes.
desc_cn: 俄里斯托科律斯位于俄耳堤西亚湾旁，西大洋与珀拉斯海间的航路途径此地。清晨自西而来的海雾与正午的烈日令酿酒葡萄得以生长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW7_2}Elvania sits on the Bay of Ortysia, part of the seaway between the western ocean and the Perassic Sea. Olive trees grow on the slopes of the nearby hills, warmed by the southern sun.
desc_cn: 厄尔凡尼亚位于俄耳堤西亚湾旁，西大洋与珀拉斯海间的航路途径此地。附近山坡上生长的橄榄树享受着南方的暖阳。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_EW8_1}Gersegos sits in the gorges of the Miron river, as it cuts between the cliffs of the Cursion Escarpment and the Dryatic mountains. Villagers have sunk mines into a spur that overlooks the village, extracting silver and other precious metals.
desc_cn: 革耳塞戈斯坐落于分割库耳西翁峭壁与德律亚山脉的弥戎河谷中。村民们在俯瞰村庄的一个山嘴上开了矿，提炼出银与其他贵金属。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW6_2}Vathea sits high on the slopes of the Dryatic mountains, facing across the valley to the great basalt slab of Mount Erithrys. The villagers mine iron from shafts sunk deep into the cliffs of the mountains.
desc_cn: 瓦忒亚坐落在德律亚山脉的高坡上，面朝的山谷对面便是巨大的玄武岩山——厄里特律斯山。村民们在陡岸上深挖竖井以开采铁矿。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K1_1}Usek sits at the foot of the Akkan hills on the eastern shores of Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers, who until recently were nomads, raise sheep known for the long, fine wool.
desc_cn: 乌赛克村坐落于库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖东岸的阿克坎丘陵之下。这里的村民不久前还过着游牧生活，他们养的绵羊身上的羊毛又长又好。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K1_2}The village of Esme and its surrounding hamlets lie on the landward side of the Akkan hills on the Devseg plateau, prime grazing lands for the flocks of the Khuzaits and their confederates.
desc_cn: 埃斯梅村及其周围的村落位于阿克坎丘陵向陆侧的德夫赛格高原。这里是库赛特及其盟友的主要放牧地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K2_1}Akiser sits in the southern reaches of the Akkan hills. The land here is exceptionally broken and weathered, revealing seams of iron in the sides of the gullies and ravines.
desc_cn: 阿契赛尔位于阿克坎丘陵的南端。该地土壤的破碎风化程度十分严重，铁矿层在沟壑间显露出来。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K5_1}Kamshar sits by the shores of Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. The fishing is poor in these parts but villagers collect clay from the lakeside for sale to the potters of Chaikhand and other towns.
desc_cn: 喀木沙位于库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖畔。当地渔业不发达，但村民们在湖边收集到了黏土，卖给柴坎和其他城镇的陶工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K3_1}The village of Hakkun is perched atop the escarpment of the Akkan hills. The people of these parts have long mined silver from the mountains, a trade that the Khuzait khans were happy to encourage when they conquered this region.
desc_cn: 哈坤村坐落在阿克坎丘陵的悬崖上。这里的人们长期在山中开采银矿，库赛特征服该地区后，历代可汗对该行业也乐于支持。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K2_4}Kiraz lies in a basin at the southern end of the Devseg plateau. Until recently, this land was dominated by nomads, and the people here still make their living by raising sheep.
desc_cn: 基拉兹位于德夫赛格高原南端的一处盆地内。不久前，这片土地还被游牧民族支配着，如今当地人仍靠饲养绵羊来谋生。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K4_1}Tepes sits overlooking a tributary of the Karakaz, a river that flows from the north into Lake Tanaz, which the Empire calls Tanaesis. This district specializes in the harvest of timber which is floated down the river and sold to the lake towns.
desc_cn: 泰佩斯村俯瞰着喀拉卡孜河的一条支流，喀拉卡孜河自北方流入帝国人称作塔奈西斯的达那孜海。该地区盛产木材，人们顺流而下，将木材销往湖边的城镇。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K1_3}Kuruluk sits alongside the Zakhan, a tributary of the Karakaz river. Though this valley is snowbound for much of the year, steppe ponies thrive on the spring grasses and in the winter dig through the snow for food, their thick coats protecting them from the icy blasts of wind.
desc_cn: 库鲁卢克位于喀拉卡孜河的支流——札罕河畔。尽管这片谷地几乎终年积雪，但草原小马仍靠吃春草和在冬天挖雪找食物的方式顽强生存，厚毛皮帮助它们抵御呼啸的刺骨寒风。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K5_1}Khimli sits in a basin the Devseg plateau. Though this land is dry most of the year, it experiences winter snowfalls and muddy springs. Fine clay can be collected from the pools left by the snowmelt and the rains.
desc_cn: 希木利位于德夫赛格高原的一块盆地内。虽然这片土地几乎终年干旱，但仍有着冬季降雪和泥泞的春季。在化雪和下雨留下的水坑处能采集到优质的黏土。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K4_1}Omrotok sits at the foot of the Sulun Dag mountains, that mark the eastern border of the Devseg plateau. Villagers go to the nearby woods to harvest one of the Devseg's few sources of timber.
desc_cn: 鄂木罗托克坐落于德夫赛格高原东边的速仑山脚下。村民们去附近的树林采伐德夫赛格为数不多的木材。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K6_1}Dinar lies in the far north of the Khuzait confederacy, along the Karakaz river. The sheep here bear unusually thick wool, as there are few trees or hills to protect them from the icy winter winds blowing down the frozen river from the northeastern steppe.
desc_cn: 迪纳尔位于库赛特部落联盟的极北之地，沿着喀拉卡孜河而建。这里几乎没有树木和山丘，无法抵御从东北草原沿冰冻的河面吹来的寒风，因此该地出产的羊毛异常浓密。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K6_2}Karahalli lies in the far north of the Khuzait confederacy, in borderlands contested by the Sturgians. Though the winters are cold, the spring grasses are fine grazing for the local sheep, whose thick wool protects them from the region's piercing winds.
desc_cn: 喀拉哈力位于库赛特部落联盟的极北之地，离冰冷的比亚里海不远，是与斯特吉亚人常年争夺得边境之地。尽管当地几乎终年积雪，但春草仍养活了相当多的绵羊，羊身上产出的厚羊毛帮助人们抵御从海面上刮来的刺骨寒风。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K7_1}Simira sits near the east of the Devseg plateau, as it begins to descend into the great grass sea of the east. Villagers here raise cattle bred to withstand both cold winters and hot summer.
desc_cn: 西米拉位于德夫赛格高原的东侧，由此再往东就进入了大草海。当地村民们饲养着能忍受寒冬酷暑的牛。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K6_4}Kohi Ajik lies in a narrow, dry valley at the foot of the so-called Lover's Mountain, from which its name derives. The peoples of this land buy horses from the nomads to their east and sell them to the Khuzait aristocracy in the towns.
desc_cn: 柯希·阿吉克位于所谓“恋人山”脚下的一条狭窄干旱的峡谷中，该地名字也源自此山。当地人从东边的游牧民那里采购马匹，然后转手卖给城镇里的库赛特贵族。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K8_1}Erzenur alongside the Tiagys river, known in the local dialect as the Teyagh. The waters here have a distinct reddish tint from the iron in the soil, which the villagers mine from riverside outcrops.
desc_cn: 埃泽努尔位于当地方言称作帖牙合的蒂亚具斯河畔。村民们在河岸边的露头岩上采铁矿，令该地的水流因泥土中含铁而呈现出微红色。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K2_3}Gereden and its outlying hamlets on the southern end of the Devseg plateau, near the juncture of Ozu and Teyagh rivers. Though rough country, it is known for the fine clay that can be gathered from the ravines.
desc_cn: 格烈登及其附属村庄一直外延至德夫赛格高原的南端，靠近斡祖河与帖牙合河的交汇处。虽然地形崎岖，但这里以山涧中产出的高品质黏土而闻名。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K9_1}Kaysar sits in the north and east of the lands ruled by the Khuzaits, in the valley of the Karakaz river. This district is snowbound for much of the year, but villagers still raise herds of cattle bred to withstand the icy winds coming downriver from the north.
desc_cn: 开撒尔位于库赛特领土的东北方，在喀拉卡孜河谷里。该地区几乎终年积雪，但村民们仍饲养着受得了顺流自北方吹来的寒风的牛群。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_K9_2}Payam lies alongside the Karakaz river in the cold north of the Khuzait lands. Though the land is snowbound much of the year, the villagers sow wheat and barley as soon as the melt starts, taking in a good crop before the autumn.
desc_cn: 帕亚木位于库赛特领土的寒冷北方，沿着喀拉卡孜河而建。尽管当地几乎终年积雪，但村民们在土地刚解冻时就播种小麦、大麦，所以秋收还不错。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S1_1}Ustokol sits on the windswept Kachyar peninsula, between the Bay of Varcheg and the Byalic Sea. Hardy northern cattle have been bred to eat the short grasses that grow among the rocks, supplemented by sea-kelp in hard times.
desc_cn: 乌斯托科坐落于瓦尔切格湾与比亚里海之间当风的卡恰尔半岛。当地人饲养的耐寒北方牛会在石缝间找小草吃，困难时期则补充一些海藻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S7_3}Zhemyan lies on the northern shores of the Kachyar peninsula. The rich grassy fields of this region make it a prime spot for local landowners to raise horses.
desc_cn: 哲米扬位于卡恰尔半岛北岸。这里草木葱茏，是当地地主饲养马匹的绝佳地点。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S2_1}Mazhadan sits near the source of the Galcha river, just west of Lake Laconis. Villagers grow flax in the muddy valleys between the hills in this cold, rainy land.
desc_cn: 马扎丹靠近伽尔喀斯河的源头，在拉科尼斯湖的正西方。这片湿冷之地的村民们会在泥泞的山谷里种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S1_2}Forin sits among rye and barley fields next to the Galcha river, on the edge of the Ircara wilds. Landowners here have turned forest-land into pasture for horses.
desc_cn: 福林坐落于伊卡拉荒原边加尔察河附近的黑麦和大麦田旁。这里的地主把林地变成了马匹的牧场。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S3_1}Nevyansk sits on a flat shelf of land overlooking the Bay of Varcheg. The land is cold, but the runoff from the hills brings rich soil, and villagers grow hardy crops like rye and barley.
desc_cn: 涅维扬斯克坐落于俯瞰瓦尔切格湾的一处平坦山角上。当地气候寒冷，但自山上流下的地表水带来了肥沃的土壤，村民们会种植黑麦、大麦等耐寒作物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S3_2}Dnin sits on pastures overlooking the narrowest part of the Bay of Varcheg. Horses graze on the heights, glancing down occasionally at the trading longships and fishing boats passing beneath them.
desc_cn: 德宁位于俯瞰瓦尔切格湾狭窄处的牧草地上。马儿们在高地吃草，偶尔瞥一眼下面经过的长船和小渔船。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S4_1}Kranirog sits in a broaded forested valley looking down on the Galcha river. The villagers in these parts are expert trappers, hunting marten, fox and rabbit for the rich pelts much in demand in the south.
desc_cn: 克拉尼罗格位于俯瞰加尔察河的开阔林谷内。此地的村民们是捕猎好手，猎取貂、狐狸和兔子的毛皮以供应南方的大量需求。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S4_2}Ismilkorg sits on grassy downs between the Galcha and Vastra rivers, two small tributaries of the Miron. The people here are mostly cattle-herders as well as cattle-rustlers, and have long traded raids with the imperial frontier villages to the east and Battanians to the west.
desc_cn: 伊斯米尔科格坐落于弥戎河的两条小支流——加尔察河与瓦斯特拉河间长满草的低地上。当地人大多既养牛又偷牛，并长期劫掠东边的帝国边境村庄和西边的巴旦尼亚人。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S5_1}Ov is a recent Sturgian colony in the Ircara wilds, a forest northwest of Lake Laconis. Villagers settled this region in search of furs, but game has largely been driven deeper into the woods and these days they raise flax in the boggy woodland.
desc_cn: 奥夫是伊卡拉荒原——拉科尼斯湖西北方的森林里一处较新的斯特吉亚殖民地。村民们最初定居于此是为了寻找毛皮，但猎物大多被驱赶到森林深处，如今他们在沼泽林地里种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S5_2}Ferkh lies at the northern edge of the Ircara wildlands, a forest northwest of Lake Laconis. It serves as a base for traders venturing deeper into the woods, brave cold, wolves and the sometimes-hostile, sometimes-friendly peoples of the woods in pursuit of fur, the bounty of the northlands.
desc_cn: 费赫位于伊卡拉荒原——拉科尼斯湖西北方森林的北部边缘处。它是冒险进入森林深处的商贩的据点，那些人需要面对严寒与狼群，以及寻求毛皮、喜怒无常的林中居民，还有北地的赏金猎人。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S6_1}Takor is a cattle raising village at the pass that the Battanians call Mynad Rhyfel, the mountain of war, and their imperial and Sturgian neighbors call Minador. It is one of the main trading and raiding routes between the wild north and the more settled imperial lands.
desc_cn: 塔科尔是一座养牛村，位于巴旦尼亚人称作“米纳德·里韦尔”，即“战争之山”的山口处。他们的帝国与斯特吉亚邻居们则称之为“弥那多耳”。这是连通荒凉北方与相对稳定的帝国疆土的主要通道之一，无论对商贸还是对劫掠来讲。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S2_3}Dvorusta is a fishing village overlooking the rapids linking the Bay of Varcheg with Lake Laconis. Villagers make their way down the cliffsides at dawn to catch salmon leaping over the rocks, as well as herring and cod in the sea.
desc_cn: 德沃鲁斯塔是一座渔村，俯瞰着连接瓦尔切格湾和拉科尼斯湖的激流。村民们在黎明时分沿着悬崖一路走下去，捕捉跃过岩石的鲑鱼，还有海里的鲱鱼和鳕鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S7_1}Urikskala sits in the Portages of Iltan, a network of glacial lakes over which longships can be hauled and sailed between lakes Laconis and Tanaesis. Villagers net small spiny perch and crayfish in the shallow waters, drying them for sale to travellers.
desc_cn: 乌里克斯卡拉位于伊勒坦运输线上，那是一张由冰川湖构成的网络，拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间往来的长船可以在上面拖动与航行。村民们在浅水处捕获带刺的鲈鱼和螯虾，将其风干后卖给旅行者们。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S5_3}Alov sits on the edge of the glacial lakes known as the Iltan portages. Villagers cultivate rye and barley on the high ground overlooking the lakes, and the rich black soil of the region compensates for the long winters and short growing season.
desc_cn: 阿洛夫位于名为伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络边缘处。村民们在俯瞰湖泊的高地上种植黑麦与大麦，肥沃的黑土补偿了当地漫长的冬季和短暂的生长期。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_S8_1}Vladiv sits at the base of Mount Iltan, in a cold, dark wooded valley. The hardy cattle of this region have learned to dig through thick winter snows in search of grass to sustain them until the spring.
desc_cn: 弗拉基夫坐落于伊勒坦山脚下寒冷阴暗的林谷中。该地区的耐寒牛在冬季会挖开厚厚的积雪找草吃，以此熬到春天。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S4_2}Glavstrom sits beneath Mount Iltan, a craggy peak in eastern Calradia named for a god of the steppe peoples. These wild lands abound with fur-bearing marten, fox, rabbits and other animals.
desc_cn: 格拉夫斯特伦坐落于东卡拉迪亚的一座峻峭险峰——伊勒坦山脚下，这座山得名自草原民族的一位神灵。这片荒野上有许多毛皮兽，如貂、狐狸、兔子等。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V1_1}Usanc sits by a small bay that flows into the larger Gulf of Charas. This warm southern land supports the growing of olive trees.
desc_cn: 于桑克坐落于汇入沙拉斯湾的一片小海湾旁。这片温暖的南方土地很适合种植橄榄树。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V2_1}Hongard sits in the warm wooded lands near the meandering Trand river. This land, rich in wheat and once the heartland of the Empire, is now the center of the Vlandian kingdom.
desc_cn: 翁加尔坐落于蜿蜒的特朗河附近的温暖林地。这片盛产小麦的土地曾是帝国的腹地，如今却成了瓦兰迪亚王国的中心。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V2_2}Ferton near a curve of the meandering Trand river, not far from a pass leading seaward over the Biscan Hills. The villagers grow olives on the warm, dry landward side of the hills.
desc_cn: 费顿在蜿蜒曲折的特朗河的一个拐角处，离通往比斯坎丘陵的山口不远。村民们在温暖、干燥的一侧山坡上种植橄榄。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V3_1}Drapand sits near the tip of Cape Fal, a promontory just south of the mouth of the Trand River. The villagers venture out far into the seas to cod-rich banks washed by a cold current from the north.
desc_cn: 德拉邦位于特朗河口正南方的法尔海角角尖处。村民们冒险远渡重洋，寻找北方寒流裹挟的鳕鱼群。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V3_1}Valanby sits overlooking the Trand estuary. The local landowners raise horses in paddocks reclaimed from the riverside marshes.
desc_cn: 瓦朗比坐瞰着特朗河河口。当地地主在河畔沼泽地开垦出的围场里饲养马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V4_1}Ormanfard sits by a small, fast-flowing river that runs down from the mountains of the Rhennod to fill the lake known as Ocspool. The hillsides here are terraced for the growing of grapes, which produce a heavy, rich vintage that the wealthy drink mixed with honey and cloves, and the common folk with water.
desc_cn: 奥曼法德位于一条湍急的小河边，这条河自莱恩诺山脉奔流而下，汇入奥克斯湖。这里的山坡被开垦成梯田用于种植葡萄，酿出的酒液醇厚浓郁。富人们会加入蜂蜜和丁香调配饮用，平民百姓则兑水享用。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V5_1}Tirby sits in the cold misty waters that lie off of the Ebor peninsula. The low-lying lands on the northern side of the Ebor are suited to the growing of flax.
desc_cn: 蒂尔比位于埃博半岛附近寒冷多雾的水域旁。埃博北边的低洼地带适合种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V5_2}Sirindac lies beneath the high ridges of the Ebor peninsula, somewhat sheltered from the bitter winds blowing out of the northwest. Villagers here dig a fine pale clay, rich in mica and feldspar, from the mountain streams.
desc_cn: 西岚达克坐落于埃博半岛的高山脚下，稍微阻挡了自西北方刮来的刺骨寒风。这里的村民从山间溪流中挖出一种细腻的浅色黏土，富含云母和长石。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V6_1}Caleus lies on the misty coastal plain south of the Bay of Varcheg. Villagers speak a mix of the Vlandian, Sturgian and Battanian tongues. They grow flax in the lowlands here.
desc_cn: 卡琉斯坐落于瓦尔切格湾南边多雾的沿海平原上。当地村民们讲一种混合了瓦兰迪亚、斯特吉亚和巴旦尼亚成分的语言，他们在低地种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V6_2}Deriat sits between the Bay of Varcheg and the ridges of the Ebor peninsula. Villagers here trap beaver and mink in the hills and sometimes pursue seals in the waters of the bay.
desc_cn: 德里亚特位于瓦尔切格湾与埃博半岛的山脊之间。当地村民会在山上捕获河狸与水貂，有时会在海湾水域捉海豹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V7_1}Talivel in the middle of the Trand valley in the heartland of Calradia. Villagers plant olives here on the hillsides.
desc_cn: 塔利维尔坐落在卡拉迪亚腹地的特朗河谷中段。当地村民们在山坡上种植橄榄。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V1_3}Rodetan takes its name from the ruddy, iron-rich soil of this part of the the Rhennod hills. The mines of this district supply the iron ore for many of the forges of the Vlandian kingdom.
desc_cn: 罗德唐之名来源于莱恩诺丘陵富含铁的红土壤。该地区的矿山为瓦兰迪亚王国的许多锻造厂供给铁矿石。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.castle_village_V8_1}Verecsand sits by the waters of the Ocspool, a small but deep inland lake. Villagers here grow wheat in the gentle downs by the lakeside.
desc_cn: 韦雷克桑位于一片小而深的内陆湖——奥克斯湖的水域旁。当地村民在湖边平坦的草原上种植小麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V2_4}Marin lies on the slopes west of the Ocspool. Misty mornings cooled by sea drifting south and warm afternoons make this land well-suited to the growing of grapes.
desc_cn: 马林位于奥克斯湖以西的缓坡上。向南的洋流令薄雾笼罩的清晨格外凉爽，温暖的下午让当地的葡萄茁壮生长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A1_1}Tasheba lies on the western edges of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Fishermen venture out into the protected waters, gentle and calm for most of the year, for tuna and sardines.
desc_cn: 塔舍巴坐落于耶什姆海的西岸。渔民们进入全年大部分时间都风平浪静的保护水域，捕捞金枪鱼和沙丁鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A1_2}Baq slightly inland from the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, beneath the great granite outcrop of the Jabal Tamar. The seawinds bring the uplands here just enough rain to support the cultivation of olive trees.
desc_cn: 巴格位于耶什姆海稍向内陆处，巨大的花岗岩露头山——塔玛尔山脚下。海风为这里的高地带来的雨水刚好够用来种些橄榄树。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A1_4}Hiblet sits at the base of the granite outcrop known as the Jabal Tamar. Rainwater trapped in cracks in the rock is diverted to the village's date-palm gardens.
desc_cn: 希卜莱特坐落于一座名为塔玛尔山的巨大花岗岩露头山脚下。人们将石缝里积蓄的雨水转移至村里的椰枣园。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A2_2}Abu Khih sits along the Nahr al-Kals river on its way to its barren southern reaches. The surrounding lands, an ancient lakebed, are already becoming barren and alkaline, although date-palms still thrive.
desc_cn: 艾布·希位于流向南方不毛之地的凯勒斯河畔。这附近的土地原先是条古河床，现在已经贫瘠与碱化，不过椰枣树仍能在此生长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A2_3}Hoqqa sits on the far east of the Aserai lands, on the Tiyagis river. The land is mostly desert-steppe. Barren most of the year except for scrub, it is covered in grass and flowers in the spring and is fine grazing for horses.
desc_cn: 胡加位于阿塞莱的远东之地，蒂亚具斯河畔。这片土地基本是荒漠草原，一年内大部分时间都很贫瘠，仅有一些灌木丛，不过春天这里会长出适合马儿吃的花草。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A3_1}Abba sits on the edge of the deep desert, at the foot of the landward side of the Jarjara Escarpment. Runoff from the hills is trapped underground here, creating springs that sustain an oasis. Wheat thrives in the fields and gardens.
desc_cn: 阿卜巴坐落于沙漠深处的边缘处，在杰尔贾赖峭壁向陆侧的山脚下。山上流下的径流在地下积蓄，形成维持绿洲的泉水，小麦在耕地与田园里茁壮成长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A3_3}Bir Seif is centered around a group of wells and pools in the Jarjara Escarpment. Villagers dig down to the shallow groundwater layer for clay to sell to the potters of the Nahasa.
desc_cn: 比尔·赛义夫坐落在杰尔贾赖峭壁大大小小的水井与湖泊之间。村民们挖到浅层地下水区收集黏土，卖给纳哈撒沙漠的陶工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A4_1}Qablab sits near a broad bay on the southern coast of the Perassic Sea. The low-lying coastline is well-suited to the construction of salt pans.
desc_cn: 加卜拉卜坐落于珀拉斯海南岸一片开阔的海湾边。地势低洼的海岸线非常适合建设盐田。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A4_2}Mussum sits near the eastern coast of the Bahr al-Yeshm sea, where the Aserai deserts give way to desert-steppe with scattered acacia and scrub. The villagers here sink wells to water their groves of date palms.
desc_cn: 穆苏姆靠近耶什姆海的东岸，阿塞莱的沙漠在这里为零星散布着金合欢树与灌木丛的荒漠草原所替代。当地村民们挖井取水来灌溉椰枣树林。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A4_4}Doqa is a fishing village on the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. Villagers sail out in feluccas to harvest perch that sometimes grow as long as a man is tall, keeping an eye out for the salt-water crocodiles which live in the local inlets and marshes and which compete with them for their catch.
desc_cn: 多加是耶什姆海岸边的一座渔村。村民们乘三桅小帆船出海捕鲈鱼，这些鲈鱼有时会长到比人还长。人们还要留意当地海湾和沼泽里的咸水鳄，它们会与村民们争夺猎物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A5_1}Mahloul sits in a broad valley between the Jarjara Escarpment and the Jabal Ashab hills in the desert steppe southeast of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Groundwater provides just enough water to grow crops for subsistence, while the village makes its money from rearing horses on the rich grass that grows in the Jabal Ashabi after the spring rains.
desc_cn: 马赫卢勒坐落于耶什姆海南侧的沙漠草原，在杰尔贾赖峭壁和阿沙卜山之间的开阔峡谷中。地下水刚好够用来种植维持生计的作物，而村民们也会在春雨季节过后放牧于阿沙比山上的丰草原，靠养马来赚点钱财。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A5_2}Liwas sits in a broad valley south of the Bahr al-Yeshm. Farmland is limited here, and the land is best known for the horses that are grazed on the desert's short-lived but rich spring grasses.
desc_cn: 利瓦斯坐落于耶什姆海南边的一座宽阔山谷内。当地农田有限，最出名的还是用荒漠上短命而肥美的春草喂养的马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A5_3}Waltas sits by the Bahr al-Yeshm, the Jade Sea, in lowlands well suited to the growing of flax.
desc_cn: 瓦勒塔斯傍着意为“翡翠之海”的拜赫尔·耶什姆。这里的低地非常适合种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A6_1}Mijayit lies off of the estuary of the Damar river as it reaches the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. The rich silt deposits left by the river make this one of the most fertile regions of the Aserai lands.
desc_cn: 达玛尔河一直蜿蜒流淌至耶什姆海，而米贾伊特就坐落于河口旁。河流携带的淤泥沉积于此，使这里成为了阿塞莱土地最肥沃的地区之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A6_2}Hamoshawat lies on the lower Damar river, just before it reaches the Bahr al-Yeshm sea. The rich silt deposits left by the river make this one of the most fertile regions of the Aserai lands.
desc_cn: 哈穆沙瓦位于达玛尔河下游的入海口处，这条河流最终汇入耶什姆海。河流携带的淤泥沉积于此，使这里成为了阿塞莱土地最肥沃的地区之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A6_3}Jahasim sits on the southern shore of the sea that the Aserai call the Bahr al-Yeshm. The warm waters abound in tuna, bonito, sardines, and other fish.
desc_cn: 贾哈西姆坐落于阿塞莱人称作“拜赫尔·耶什姆”的内海之南岸。当地温暖的水域盛产金枪鱼、鲣鱼、沙丁鱼等鱼类。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A6_4}Nahlan sits on the floodplain of the Damar River as it cuts through the Jarjara escarpment. This soil, refreshed yearly by the silt of the flooding river, produces bountiful crops of wheat.
desc_cn: 纳赫兰坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁被达玛尔河分割形成的冲积平原上。当地的土壤每年都会因洪流带来的淤泥而恢复肥力，所以小麦产量很高。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A7_2}Bait Hatif sits in the floodplain of the Damar river as it cuts through the Jarjara Escarpment. Rocky soil in this district limits irrigation, but horses thrive on the spring grasses of the hills.
desc_cn: 拜特·哈提夫坐落于杰尔贾赖峭壁被达玛尔河分割形成的冲积平原上。该地区的石质土壤限制了灌溉效果，不过山上的春草可以让马儿茁壮成长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A7_3}Mabwaz overlooks the Damar River as it weaves through the mesas of the Jarjara Escarpment. Villagers grow wheat and other crops in the silt of the river floodplain.
desc_cn: 马卜瓦兹俯瞰着蜿蜒穿过杰尔贾赖峭壁台地的达玛尔河。村民们在河漫滩的淤泥上种植小麦与其他作物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A7_4}Zalm sits at the Scorched Gates, where the Damar river descends from the Nahasa desert and starts its journey through the Jarjara Escarpment. The silt brought by the river produces bountiful crops of wheat.
desc_cn: 扎勒姆坐落于枯焦之门，达玛尔河在此处从纳哈撒沙漠发源并穿过杰尔贾赖峭壁。河水携带的淤泥使得当地小麦的收成很好。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A8_1}Ezbet Nahul sits on a rocky shelf overlooking the waters that the Aserai call the Bahr al-Yeshm, the Jade Sea. Groundwater trapped by the rocks is accessed by wells and used to irrigate the village wheatfields.
desc_cn: 艾兹贝特·纳胡勒位于俯瞰着阿塞莱人称作“拜赫尔·耶什姆”，即“翡翠之海”一处多岩山角上。石缝间积蓄的地下水可从井里获取，用来灌溉村里的小麦田。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_A8_2}Abghan sits by a small lagoon on the southern shores of the Bahr al-Yeshm, the Jade Sea. Villagers here fish for tuna, sardines, bonito and shark.
desc_cn: 阿卜甘位于“拜赫尔·耶什姆”，即“翡翠之海”南岸的一片小潟湖边。当地村民捕捞金枪鱼、沙丁鱼、鲣鱼与鲨鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B1_1}Dalmengus sits by the side of the Llyn Tywal, the Dark Lake at the center of the Uchalion massif. The flat, well-watered lands here are fertile and well-suited to wheat and barley.
desc_cn: 达尔门格斯位于泰瓦尔湖——即乌卡利翁地块中央的暗湖之畔。这里的土地平坦肥沃且雨水丰沛，很适合种植小麦与大麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B1_2}Ebereth sits on a saddle, with the lake of Llyn Tywal on one side and the passes of the Cafalcombe on the other. Villagers here grow grapes to make the sweet white wine of the Battanian lands.
desc_cn: 埃贝雷斯坐落于一处鞍状山脊上，一边是泰瓦尔湖，另一边则通往卡瓦尔谷的隘口。当地村民们种植葡萄来酿造巴旦尼亚地区甘甜的白葡萄酒。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B1_3}Beglomuar sits in a nook of the southern escarpment of the Uchalion massif. There is little to recommend these lands other than the ore deposits in the hills and the bog-iron of the mountain marshes.
desc_cn: 贝格洛米艾位于乌卡利翁地块南边峭壁的一处角落里。除了山上的矿床与沼泽的沼铁矿之外，这里就没什么吸引人的地方了。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B1_4}Ath Cafal sits near the head of the Cafalcombe, a steep valley that descends to the imperial lands. Decent clay can be found in the small streams that rush down from the hills on all sides.
desc_cn: 阿斯·卡瓦尔靠近卡瓦尔谷——通往帝国领土的陡峭山谷之起始端。山上奔流而下的小溪中可以收集到优质的黏土。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B2_1}Diantogmail sits on the edge of Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. There are a half-dozen local legends explaining how the region got its name, which means the 'Flight of the Stoat,' but no two of them match in any particulars. Villagers here gather clay from the lakeside for use by nearby artisans.
desc_cn: 迪安托格麦尔位于“林·泰瓦尔”，即“暗湖”之畔。有数种本地传说解释该地名字的由来——意为“白鼬之翔”，但没有任意两种版本的细节能对得上。这里的村民会从湖边收集黏土，供附近的工匠使用。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B2_2}Glenlithrig, the valley of the slippery stream, lies in the highlands of the northern Uchalion. The villagers here are primarily foresters, supplying timber to the nearby fortress-towns of Dunglanys and Car Banseth.
desc_cn: 格伦利斯里格——一条湿滑的溪谷——位于乌卡利翁北边的高地上。当地村民主要都是林农，为附近的要塞城镇邓格拉尼斯和卡·班塞斯提供木材。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B2_3}Morihig sits in a basin in the middle of the Uchalion massif. The region is known for its production of wheat and barley.
desc_cn: 莫里希格坐落于乌卡利翁地块中部的一块盆地中。该地区以盛产小麦和大麦而闻名。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B3_1}Bog Beth sits in a low, forested valley in the east of the Uchalion massif. Villagers trap beavers, foxes and other fur-bearing animals in the dark, marshy woods.
desc_cn: 博格·贝斯坐落于乌卡利翁地块东部一座地势低矮的林谷中。村民们在阴暗的沼泽林地里用陷阱捕捉河狸、狐狸和其他毛皮兽。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B3_2}Geunat Nal, the village where Nal left his head, is a fur-trapping village near the site of a duel famous in Battanian legend. The villagers are known for their skill as foresters, helping the nearby cliff-top fortress of Car Banseth to guard the northern approaches to the Battanian heartland from Sturgian and other raiders.
desc_cn: 格纳特·纳尔是巴旦尼亚传说中决斗之地附近的一座村庄，据传纳尔在此留下了他的头颅。当地村民们以出色的护林人技能而闻名，他们帮助附近悬崖上的卡·班塞斯要塞抵御斯特吉亚人和其他掠夺者的攻击，保护着巴旦尼亚的腹地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B3_3}Tor Leiad, the hill of the full moon, lies beneath a wooded knoll in the northern Battanian lands. Villagers harvest the thick-growing forests of oak, yew and beech. The woods here have been tended carefully by the Battanians for centuries, ensuring that there are always enough trees to harvest and sell for timber.
desc_cn: 托·莱阿德，满月之丘，坐落于巴旦尼亚北部的一座树木繁茂的小山丘下。当地村民们砍伐橡树、紫杉和山毛榉林。几百年来，巴旦尼亚人悉心照料着这些树木，保证木材一直足够采伐和贩卖。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B4_1}Bryn Glas sits in a ridge in the eastern escarpment of the Uchalion massif. Villagers raise grapes on the slopes, making a strong, dark red wine highly valued by the Vlandians and the Empire.
desc_cn: 布林·格拉斯坐落于乌卡利翁地块东边的悬崖上。村民们在山坡上种植葡萄，酿造出浓郁的深红色葡萄酒，深受瓦兰迪亚人和帝国人的喜爱。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B4_2}Andurn sits in a cleft in the hills overlooking Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. The villagers of these parts tend the forests, harvesting beech, oak and yew for sale to the towns.
desc_cn: 安杜恩坐落于俯瞰“林·泰瓦尔”——即暗湖的山上裂口处。该地区的村民种植树木，采伐山毛榉、橡树和紫杉，再销往各城镇。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B4_3}Mag Arba sits on grassy downs overlooking Llyn Tywal, the dark lake. Villagers have planted flax in the boggy dales between the hills.
desc_cn: 马格·阿尔巴坐落于俯瞰“林·泰瓦尔”——即暗湖的草场上。村民们在泥泞的山谷里种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B4_4}Swenryn overlooks the rocky cataract that holds back the dark waters of the Llyn Tywal, creating the lake in the center of the Uchalion. Horses graze above the rapids and waterfalls.
desc_cn: 斯温林俯瞰着岩石大瀑布，它阻挡了泰瓦尔湖的黑暗水域，形成乌卡利翁中央的湖泊。马儿在激流与瀑布之上的草地上觅食。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B5_1}Durn sits just below the gorges of the upper Trand river. Villagers scrape mud from the pools and bogs alongside the river as it levels out, carting it up the winding paths to the town of Pen Cannoc perched on the cliff above them.
desc_cn: 杜恩位于特朗河上游峡谷的下方。当水流平缓时，村民们从河边的水池和泥塘里刮取淤泥，沿着蜿蜒的小路把淤泥运到他们上方悬崖处的彭·坎诺克城。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B5_2}Gainseth sits in a dark wooded valley beneath the Rhennod hills on the eastern edge of the Uchalion massif. Villagers collect mud from the marshy ground for sale to the potters of Pen Cannoc.
desc_cn: 盖恩塞斯位于乌卡利翁地块的东部边界、莱恩诺丘陵下一座阴暗的林谷中。当地村民们在湿地里收集泥土，卖给彭·坎诺克的陶工。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_B5_3}Fenon Etir sits on an outcrop overlooking the source of the Etir river, a tributary of the Trand. Below the village the water winds between mounds of slag, the detritus from centuries of mining the iron-rich ores of the nearby hills.
desc_cn: 韦农·埃蒂尔坐落于俯瞰特朗河支流——埃蒂尔河源头的一座露头山上。村庄下方，河水蜿蜒流淌于成堆的矿渣之间，这些矿渣是数百年来在附近山丘上开采富铁矿留下的残骸。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN1_1}Marathea lies on a narrow shelf of land between the Miron river and Mount Aracathos, the tallest peak in the Dryatic mountains. The villagers are skilled miners, extracting iron ores from the nearby cliffside.
desc_cn: 马拉忒亚坐落于弥戎河和德律亚山脉最高峰——阿拉卡托斯山之间的狭窄土地上。当地村民是熟练矿工，从附近的悬崖边开采铁矿石。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN1_2}Stathymos lies in a narrow valley beneath a towering ridge of the Dryatic mountains. The highland streams wash fertile soil down the hillsides, making this district one of the breadbaskets of the imperial north.
desc_cn: 斯塔堤摩斯位于德律亚山脉高耸山脊下的一条狭长山谷中。高地的溪流灌溉着山坡上的沃土，使该地区成为了帝国北方的“粮仓”之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN1_3}Gymos is a quiet fishing village in the Diathmic Bay, on the far west of Lake Laconis. Villagers harvest pike from the bay's deep waters.
desc_cn: 居摩斯位于拉科尼斯湖以西很远处，是狄亚特马湾旁的一座僻静渔村。当地村民们会在海湾的深水区捕捞梭子鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN2_1}Alosea lies near the entrance of the Diathmic Bay, on the far western end of Lake Laconis. The folk of this region live well off the pike and sturgeon of the lake.
desc_cn: 阿罗塞亚在拉科尼斯湖以西很远处，靠近狄亚特马湾的入口。当地人依靠湖中捕捞的梭子鱼和鲟鱼生活得很富足。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN2_2}Jeracos sits in meadowland in the northern piedmont of the Dryatic mountains. The slopes of the nearby hills are pierced with mineshafts. Despite centuries of use, they still yield ores from which silver can be extracted through various cunning techniques.
desc_cn: 耶拉科斯坐落于德律亚山脉北部山麓的草场上。已被开采了几个世纪的矿井仍然蕴藏着丰富的矿石，人们可以通过各种巧妙的技术从中提取银。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN3_1}Enoisa sits by the shores of the Ophthys, the eye, a deep lake in the hill country south of the Dryatic mountains. Wheat grows here, fed by the ample rains of the north. Legend has it that this was once a shrine of the ancient Palaic people, who believed the lake was a gateway to another world.
desc_cn: “大地之眼”俄佛堤斯，德律亚山脉南部山区的一片深湖，岸边就是厄诺伊萨。从北方来的充足降水润泽着这里的小麦。传说此处是古帕拉人的圣地，他们认为这片湖是通往另一个世界的门户。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN3_3}Crios lies nestled amid the limestone ridges of the eastern Dryatic mountains. The highland soils make fine grazing for horses.
desc_cn: 克里俄斯位于德律亚山脉东边的石灰岩山脊上。高地土壤适合生长优质的马草。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN4_2}Alatys lies on the flat southern end of Lake Laconis, on delta lowlands formed by the River Nevys. The waters of the lake, which are very shallow and muddy here, are well-stocked with flounder and crayfish, while trout can be fished in the Nevys upstream.
desc_cn: 阿拉堤斯位于拉科尼斯湖平坦的南端，在涅维斯河塑造的三角低地上。当地又浅又浑的湖水中有大量比目鱼和小龙虾，在涅维斯河上游还能捕到鳟鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN4_4}Hetania sits beneath a spur on the far northeastern bend of the Dryatic mountains. As in many villages around here, the foresters of this region still speak the Palaic languages of the tribes who lived here before the Empire came.
desc_cn: 赫塔尼亚坐落于德律亚山脉东北部的一个山嘴下。同这附近的许多村庄一样，当地的林农依然说着帕拉语。在帝国入侵之前，帕拉语是这里各部落所说的语言。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN5_1}Vealos sits in the slowly rising eastern slopes of the Dryatic mountains in the eastern reaches of the Empire. Although mostly covered with beech and oak woods, the mountain slopes provide good grazing for horses and has traditionally been home to stud farms for the imperial cavalry.
desc_cn: 威亚罗斯坐落于帝国东边德律亚山脉东侧的缓坡上。尽管山坡基本覆盖着山毛榉和橡树林，这里还是能产出很好的马草，而且此处自古以来就是帝国军马的育种地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN5_2}Orthra, a relatively recent settlement, was named by an imperial captain after the dawn for its fine eastward views of the Myzead, the hill country of the eastern empire. It was founded as a stud farm to breed imperial horses with steppe stock from the east, and continues to provide horses for the imperial cavalry.
desc_cn: 俄耳特拉是一座相对较年轻的定居点，得名自一位帝国将领，他于破晓时分在此东望，看到密泽亚德的美景后就命名了日后这座帝国东部的山村。这里是帝国的马匹育种场，从东方草原运来牧草，为帝国骑兵部队提供马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN5_4}Samatha sits upon a sloping ridge in the sun-drenched highlands of the Myzead. The hillsides have been terraced to allow the growing of mulberry bushes. The leaves are harvested, placed in vats and fed to silkworms.
desc_cn: 萨马塔位于阳光普照的密泽亚德高地的一处斜坡上。山坡被改造成了梯田，方便种植桑树。人们采集这些桑叶，放到大桶里喂蚕。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN6_1}Avasinton sits in the wilder eastern reaches of the Myzead, the hill country of the central empire. Villagers have cleared away the thickets and thornbrush of this region, including the pungent wormwood after which the village is named, to allow the growing of mulberry bushes, the leaves of which are harvested and fed to silkworms.
desc_cn: 阿瓦辛顿坐落于帝国中部山区密泽亚德荒凉的东端。村民们清理掉了这个地区的灌木丛和荆棘，包括刺鼻的艾草（该村庄曾以这种艾草为名），方便腾出地方种植桑树，然后收集桑叶养蚕。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EN6_2}Boreagora lies in the cold north of the Empire, by the network of glacial lakes known as the portages of Iltan. Nearby imperial forts, looming over the waterways, keep watch for Sturgian and Khuzait raiders. The lowlands here are suited to the growing of flax.
desc_cn: 玻瑞阿戈拉位于帝国寒冷的北方，被伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络所包围。附近的帝国堡垒在水路上若隐若现，监视着斯特吉亚和库赛特的劫掠者。这里的低地很适合种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES1_2}Polisia sits among the network of rivers and lakes known as the Calsea near the Aserai borderlands. Villagers harvest salt from a lagoon to their west, a former inlet of the Perassic sea that was cut off by a sandspit. These lowlands are shunned by many others in Calradia, who find the air thick and fetid, but the inhabitants are proud of their role keeping watch on the Aserai.
desc_cn: 波利西亚坐落于阿塞莱边境被称为卡勒萨的河湖交通网旁。村民们从西边的一片潟湖中采盐，那里被沙嘴分割前，曾是珀拉斯海的一片海湾。卡拉迪亚大陆的其他居民经过这片低地时都会绕道而走，因为这里的空气又浑又臭，但是当地人都对自己监视阿塞莱人的职责引以为傲。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES1_3}Tegresos sits just north of the River Calsa, right before it enters the network of lakes, creeks and lagoons that form the borderlands with the Aserai. The inhabitants of this region have bred sheep that feed on marsh-grasses.
desc_cn: 泰格瑞索斯位于卡勒萨河北边，它勾勒出阿塞莱的边界，然后汇入湖泊、溪流和潟湖的交通网中。当地村民饲养着以沼泽里的草为食的绵羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES1_4}Erebulos lies by a lagoon that was formerly part of the Perassic Sea, closed by a recently formed sandspit. Villagers scoop clay from the creek-bottoms here, selling it to the pottery kilns of Danustica and other nearby towns.
desc_cn: 厄瑞玻洛斯位于一片潟湖旁，这片潟湖被最近形成的沙嘴所封闭前，曾是珀拉斯海的一部分。村民们从溪底挖出黏土，然后卖给达努提斯卡和附近城镇的陶窑。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES2_2}Gorcorys sits on the Gorea, the southernmost tributary of the Sethys river in the valley of Tripotamia. The dark, well-watered soil here makes this region an imperial breadbasket.
desc_cn: 戈耳科律斯坐落于歌里亚河畔，那是塞堤斯河流经三河河谷最南端的支流。水量充沛的黑土使得这片地区成为了“帝国粮仓”。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES2_3}Avalyps sits near the headwaters of the River Calsa in the warm coastal hills of the southern Empire. The dark, well-watered soil here makes this region an imperial breadbasket.
desc_cn: 阿瓦吕普斯靠近卡勒萨河上游，位于南帝国海边的温暖山丘上。水量充沛的黑土使得这片地区成为了“帝国粮仓”。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES2_4}Alision lies on the northern coast of the Perassic Sea. Though fishing is poor in these parts, villagers have constructed salt pans that stick far out into the shallow waters.
desc_cn: 阿利西翁坐落于珀拉斯海北岸。当地渔业相当不景气，于是村民们在浅滩处建造了盐田。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES3_1}Canoros sits in the flat southern reaches of the Lycarea plain. This land has been good horse country since even before the Empire came, furnishing the steeds of the Lycarean riders who routed several Calradian armies before their final defeat and absorption into the imperial cavalry.
desc_cn: 卡诺洛斯位于吕卡里亚平原平坦的南端。在帝国入侵前，该地就是一处很好的养马区，为吕卡里亚的骑手供应追逐卡拉德敌人的骏马，直到前者最终战败并被吸收进帝国骑兵部队。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES3_2}Tevea sits where the plains of Lycarea slowly ascend to meet the base of the Ornian Rock, named for the vultures who perch on its crags to keep watch on the hazy plains below. Depressions lying in the shadow of the rock remain wet for most of the year, making for good land in which to grow flax.
desc_cn: 特维亚坐落于吕卡里亚谷中平地向奥尼石山基底缓慢爬升的中间地带。奥尼石山得名自栖息于峭壁之上，俯瞰着雾蒙蒙的平原的秃鹫。石山阴面下的洼地一年中大部分时间都保持湿润，是种植亚麻的良田。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES3_3}Zestea sits where the plains of Lycarea meet the coastal Iltaric hills. Swine forage for acorns in the oak groves overlooking the hazy flatlands.
desc_cn: 泽斯特亚位于吕卡里亚平原与海边伊勒塔尔丘陵的交界处。猪群在俯瞰着薄雾朦胧的平地的缓坡上吃草。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES4_1}Sagora sits on a low ridge in the middle of the Lycarean plain. This district is one of the rockier and less fertile parts of the plain, but the valley scrub still supports the grazing of sheep.
desc_cn: 萨戈拉坐落在吕卡里亚平原中央的一处低矮山脊上。该地区属于平原上岩石较多，较不肥沃的地方之一，但山谷的灌木丛仍可以供羊啃食。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES4_3}Canterion lies in the east of the Lycarean plain. The slowly rising land here gets more rain than other parts of the plain, and the rich grasses have made it good horse country since even before the coming of the Empire.
desc_cn: 坎忒里翁坐落于吕卡里亚平原东部，这里缓缓上升的坡地比平原的其他地方降雨更多。早在帝国入侵前，当地肥美的牧草就使其成为了一处优良的养马区。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES5_1}Lanthas lies in the broad plains south of Lake Tanaesis. This is good sheep country, but in a land scoured by imperial fugitives, wild Eleftheroi riders and steppe nomads, the villagers here have learned to watch their flocks closely.
desc_cn: 兰塔斯躺在塔奈西斯湖以南的广阔平原上。这里是优质绵羊之乡，但这片地区会被帝国逃犯、自由民骑手和草原游牧民扫荡，当地村民已经学会了看紧羊群。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES5_2}Lartusys lies near the southern end of Lake Tanaesis. The village sits near a deposit of salt, and salt springs occasionally bubble to the surface, feeding the legend that this was once a gateway to a haunted underground sea.
desc_cn: 拉耳图绪斯位于塔奈西斯湖的南端。村庄附近有座盐矿，盐泉偶尔会探出水面，让人们相信这就是传说中通往鬼怪聚集的地下海的门户。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES5_3}Parasemnos sits in a low pass linking the Tanaeitic plain with the valley of the Calsa river. The villagers mine salt from deposits beneath the ridges on the Calsean side of the pass.
desc_cn: 帕拉森诺斯坐落于连通塔尼平原与卡勒萨河的低矮隘口旁。村民们从山口卡勒萨一侧山脊下的矿床中采盐。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES6_1}Saldannis lies beneath gypsum bluffs overlooking the River Sethys. The fine soil of the hills makes for a sticky clay when it washes down to the river, much prized by the potters of the imperial south.
desc_cn: 萨尔丹尼斯位于石膏峭壁之下，俯瞰着塞堤斯河。山上的细土被水流冲刷下来形成黏土，这是能让帝国南方的陶工们两眼放光的东西。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES6_2}Spotia lies alongside the gently flowing Sethys river. The low rolling hills of this district comprise one of the breadbaskets of the Empire.
desc_cn: 斯珀提亚坐落于缓缓流淌的塞堤斯河畔。这里高低起伏的丘陵构成了帝国的“粮仓”之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES7_1}Psotai sits near the southern tip of Lake Tanaesis. The low-lying fields here are one of the major grain producing centers of the eastern frontier regions.
desc_cn: 索泰位于塔奈西斯湖南端。这里地势低洼，是东部边境地区的主要产粮地之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_ES7_2}Vargornis is a fishing village on Lake Tanaesis. Huge pike can sometimes be found in the lake's waters, along with more common perch and bream.
desc_cn: 瓦耳戈尼斯是塔奈西斯湖畔的一座渔村。湖中有时能发现巨型梭鱼，还有更常见的鲈鱼和鲷鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW1_1}Primessos lies in the wooded upper reaches of the Gavys valley. Pigs, fed on the acorns of the southern oak trees, thrive in this climate.
desc_cn: 普里墨索斯位于伽维斯河谷树木繁茂的上游。当地气候适合饲养以南方橡树的橡子为食的猪。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW1_2}Montos sits at the base of the Cursion escarpment, near the Battanian frontier. The foresters here keep a watchful eye on their neighbors, always looking for raiding parties coming westward from the valley of the Miron river to their east.
desc_cn: 蒙托斯坐落于库耳西翁峭壁的底端，靠近巴旦尼亚边境。当地林农密切关注着他们的邻居，总在防备那些试图自东向西跨过弥戎河的劫掠者。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW2_2}Neocorys, the new village, sits in gently sloping land in the Temea valley cleared only recently of forest. The local landowners have established stud farms, supplying horses to the imperial cavalry.
desc_cn: 涅俄科律斯是一个新村，位于特美亚山谷的一处缓坡上，该地最近才由一片森林开辟而成。当地地主们建了育种场，为帝国骑兵部队提供马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW2_3}Alsasos sits in the west end of the Temea, a broad valley north of the Perassic sea. Though the climate is relatively dry here, artesian wells allow farmers to grow bountiful crops of wheat.
desc_cn: 阿尔萨索斯位于珀拉斯海北边的宽阔山谷——特美亚的西部。尽管当地气候相对干旱，但农民们依靠自流井水仍有很好的小麦收成。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW2_4}Zeocorys at the foot of the Ilataric hills, running along the southern coast of the Empire. Though the climate is relatively dry here, artesian wells allow farmers to grow bountiful crops of wheat.
desc_cn: 泽俄科律斯位于伊勒塔尔丘陵脚下，沿着南帝国的海岸线而建。尽管当地气候相对干旱，但农民们依靠自流井水仍有很好的小麦收成。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW3_2}Aegosca sits at the head of the Temea, a broad valley in southern Calradia. Though named for the goats that used to roam this region, the landowners have turned over the pastures to the raising of far more profitable horses.
desc_cn: 埃戈斯卡位于卡拉迪亚南部的宽阔山谷——特美亚的起始端。虽然该地区得名自过去漫步于此的山羊，但地主们已经在这片草场改养利润丰厚得多的马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW3_3}Dradios sits by the Lesser Amynis, a tributary stream of the Aminys river that rushes down from the heights above. Villagers divert the mountain streams to irrigate their rich grainfields.
desc_cn: 得拉狄俄斯坐落于自高地奔流而下的阿米尼斯河的支流——小阿米尼斯河畔。当地村民们将山上的径流改道，用以灌溉肥沃的麦地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW4_1}Arpotis sits on a high bluff overlooking the confluences of the Aminys, Gavys and Zeos rivers. The sides of the hills are terraced to grow wheat, with cisterns to catch the rain blowing up from the sea.
desc_cn: 阿耳波提斯坐落于高崖之上，俯瞰着阿米尼斯河、伽维斯河和泽俄斯河的交汇处。山的两边是梯田，还建有蓄水池，收集来自海洋的雨云所携带的淡水。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW4_3}Vinela sits beneath the waterfalls where the Aminys river rushes down to join the Perassic Sea. Fishing boats set out each day from beneath the coastal cliffs, harvesting mackerel, sardines and bonito from the rich waters where the river meets the sea.
desc_cn: 维尼拉坐落于阿米尼斯河倾入珀拉斯海的瀑布之下。每天，渔船从海岸悬崖下出发，在河流入海的肥沃水域捕捞鲭鱼、沙丁鱼和鲣鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW4_4}Garengolia lies near a rich vein of silver in hills overlooking the Gavys river. The Empire have minted its denars from these mines for centuries.
desc_cn: 伽伦戈利亚位于一条储藏丰富的银矿脉旁，俯瞰着伽维斯河。几个世纪以来，帝国一直用这里出产的银矿铸造第纳尔。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW5_1}Elipa sits near the upper reaches of the Aris valley. These sunny, well-watered highlands are one of the breadbaskets of the Empire.
desc_cn: 厄利帕坐落于阿里斯河谷上游。这片光照充足、水源丰沛的高地是帝国重要的“粮仓”之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW5_2}Phasos sits amid rolling chalk hills between the Temea and Aris valleys. The rich grass of the down is some of the best horse-breeding land in the Empire.
desc_cn: 法索斯位于特美亚与阿里斯河谷间高地起伏的白垩山丘中。低处肥美的牧草使这里成为了帝国最好的养马地之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW6_1}Carphenion lies in the wooded highlands between the great basalt slab of Mount Erithrys and the Dryatic mountains. The villagers raise cattle in the highland pastures.
desc_cn: 卡耳斐尼翁位于玄武岩巨山——厄里特律斯山和德律亚山脉之间树木繁茂的高地上。村民们在高地牧场上养牛。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW6_3}Thersenion sits in the upper Aminys valley, in the shadow of Mount Erithrys, a great basalt slab thrust up from the depths of the earth. This district is one of the grain breadbaskets of the Empire.
desc_cn: 忒耳塞尼翁坐落在阿米尼斯河谷上游，在拔地而起的玄武岩巨山——厄里特律斯山之下。该地区是帝国的“粮仓”之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_EW6_4}Leblenion lies alongside the Aminys river in the shadow of Mount Erithrys, a great basalt slab thrust up from the depths of the earth. This district is one of the grain breadbaskets of the Empire.
desc_cn: 勒布伦尼翁位于拔地而起的玄武岩巨山——厄里特律斯山下的阿米尼斯河旁。这个地区是帝国的“粮仓”之一。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K1_1}Fisnar sits alongside the Zakhan, a tributary of the Karakaz river. Snow-bound for much of the year, the spring grasses nonetheless sustain sizeable herds of sheep, the thick wool of which protects them from the bitter winter cold.
desc_cn: 菲斯纳尔位于喀拉卡孜河的支流——札罕河畔。该地几乎终年积雪，但春草仍养活了相当多的绵羊，羊身上厚厚的羊毛帮助它们抵御严酷的寒冬。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K1_2}Ulaan sits in the valley of the Karakaz river. The villagers, nomads who have recently been forced by the khans to settle, have learned to grow flax in this low-lying marshy land.
desc_cn: 乌兰坐落于喀拉卡孜河的河谷中。当地村民都是被可汗强令定居没多久的游牧民，他们已经学会了在这片低洼的泥泞地上种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K1_4}Asalig sits at the foot of Bars Dag, one of the peaks that marks the edge of the Devseg plateau. Villagers raise horses in the lower slopes, keeping watch for the snow leopards for which the peak is named.
desc_cn: 阿萨利格坐落于德夫赛格高原之巅的巴尔思山脚下。村民们在相对低矮的山坡上养马，并时刻提防着雪豹——此山正是因此而得名。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K2_1}Karakalat lies in a basin in the flat, eastern edges of the Devseg plateau. Until recently, this land was dominated by nomads, and it is still famous as a breeding ground for horses.
desc_cn: 喀拉卡拉特位于德夫赛格高原东部平缓边缘的一处盆地内。不久前，这片土地还被游牧民族支配着，当地如今仍以繁育良马而闻名 。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K2_2}Tismil sits on the Ozu river, which drains the southern end of the Devseg plateau. The people of this land are sheep-herders, who have thrived under Khuzait overlordship as the khans keep nomadic raiders at bay.
desc_cn: 帖斯密勒位于发源自德夫赛格高原南端的斡祖河畔。当地居民是牧羊人，由于历代可汗对马匪的打击清剿，他们得以在库赛特的强权统治下安稳生活。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K3_1}Shapeshte sits where the waters of the Zakhan river meet the Karakaz. The village makes its living from mining nearby salt deposits.
desc_cn: 沙佩什特位于札罕河与喀拉卡孜河的交汇处。村民们靠开采附近的盐矿谋生。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K3_2}Hanekhy sits atop a northern spur of the Akkan hills. The reddish streaks in the soil and rocks testify to rich iron deposits, which are mined by the villagers.
desc_cn: 哈内希坐落于阿克坎丘陵北部的一处山嘴上。土壤和岩石上的红色条纹说明该地富含铁矿，而村民们正在开采。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K3_3}The fishing village of Mazen sits on the northern end of Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz sea. The villagers set nets in the nearby Karakaz river to catch a variety of fish migrating to and from the lake.
desc_cn: 渔村马津坐落于库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖的北端。村民们在喀拉卡孜河附近布下渔网，捕捉往返于湖中的各种鱼类。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K4_2}Ransam in the southeastern plains of the Devseg plateau. Villagers, who not long ago still lived a nomadic lifestyle, specialize in the rearing of horses.
desc_cn: 兰萨木位于德夫赛格高原东南方的平原上。不久前还以游牧为生的村民们精于饲养马匹。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K4_3}Mivanjan sits at the foot of the Sulun Dag mountains, which mark the eastern border of the Devseg plateau. Villagers, who not long ago still lived a nomadic lifestyle, raise sheep in the foothills.
desc_cn: 米万占坐落于德夫赛格高原东边的速仑山脚下。不久前，村民们还过着游牧生活，如今却在山麓小丘饲养绵羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K4_4}Urunjan near the western edge of the Devseg plateau, at the foot of the Akkan hills. Villagers raise cattle here that are bred to withstand both the hot summers and freezing winters.
desc_cn: 乌伦占位于阿克坎山脚下，靠近德夫赛格高原的西端。当地村民养牛以抵御寒冬与酷暑。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K5_2}Okhutan is a village at the center of a wheat-growing district on a narrow stretch of plain between the Akkan hills and Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea.
desc_cn: 奥胡坦是一座位于小麦种植区中央的村庄，地处库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖与阿克坎丘陵之间的狭长平原。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K5_3}Ispantar is a village on a rocky spur of the Akkan hills overlooking Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. The villagers here make most of their income from the raising of sheep.
desc_cn: 依斯潘塔尔位于阿克坎丘陵的一处多岩山嘴上，俯瞰着库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖。当地村民的主要收入来源是养羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K5_4}Pabastan sits in the narrow plain between the Akkan hills and Lake Tanaesis, which the Khuzaits call the Tanaz Sea. This land is fine country for wheat.
desc_cn: 帕巴斯坦坐落于阿克坎丘陵与库赛特人称作达那孜海的塔奈西斯湖之间的狭长平原上。这是个种植小麦的好地方。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K6_1}Karahan lies in in the foothills of the Kohi Rohini, the mountains of the dawn. The villagers here buy horses from the wandering tribes, and raise some of their own, making this the source for many of the steeds ridden by the Khuzait armies.
desc_cn: 喀拉罕位于柯希·罗希尼——黎明山脉山麓的丘陵地带。当地村民向迁徙的部落购买马匹，自己也饲养一些，库赛特军队的许多马匹都来源于此。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K6_2}Nutyuk sits beneath the outcrop known by its Darshi name, the Kohi Rohini, the mountains of the dawn. The villagers here, mostly recently settled nomads, raise sheep like their ancestors.
desc_cn: 努丘克位于一片露头岩山脉之下，该山的达西语名为柯希·罗希尼，即黎明山脉。当地村民多是新近定居的游牧民，他们像祖先一样饲养绵羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_K6_3}Danara sits by the salt lake that the Khuzaits know as Tsanga Nor, the pool that quenches no thirst. The villagers of these parts extract salt from the bitter waters.
desc_cn: 达纳拉位于库赛特人称作昌尕淖尔的不解渴的盐湖旁。当地村民们从苦涩的湖水中提取盐。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S1_1}Rodobas, the house of Obas, is named for a long-dead Sturgian hill chieftain. Perched high on a ridge overlooking the wilds of Ircara, it serves as a base for trappers looking for furs in the dark woods below,
desc_cn: 罗多巴斯，“奥巴斯之屋”，得名自山上的一位亡故已久的斯特吉亚酋长。该村坐落在俯瞰伊卡拉荒原的山脊上，去山下黑暗的森林中猎取毛皮的猎人们将这里作为基地。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S1_3}Kargrev was once Car Gryff, the ringfort of the Battanian chief Gryff, but was conquered by the Sturgians two generations ago. It lies alongside the Bay of Varcheg, where the local fishermen take advantage of the relatively sheltered waters of the bay, where fish of many kinds come to spawn.
desc_cn: 卡格雷夫曾经叫作卡尔·格莱夫——巴旦尼亚酋长格莱夫的环形堡垒，但两代人之前此地被斯特吉亚人征服。它位于瓦尔切格湾沿岸，湾内海水相对平静，许多种鱼在繁殖期都会游到这里来，当地渔民很好地利用了这一点。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S2_1}Safna sits on a high ridge overlooking the rapids that link Lake Laconis to the narrow Mazopor Bay. Villagers grow wheat just inland of the sea-cliffs, where the land is sheltered from the salt air.
desc_cn: 萨夫纳坐落于俯瞰激流的高耸山脊上，激流连接了拉科尼斯湖与狭窄的马佐波尔湾。村民们在靠近海崖的内陆种植小麦，那里的土地可以免受盐风的侵袭。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S2_2}Marabrot sits on a high rocky ridge between the fjord known as Mazopor Bay and the Byalic Sea. This harsh land would probably not be settled where it not for the rich iron deposits in the hills.
