desc_cn: 马拉布罗特坐落于马佐波尔湾与比亚里海之间高耸的多岩山脊上。这片苦寒之地要是没有山上丰富的铁矿，估计就不会有人定居于此。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S3_1}Chornobas, or Blackwood, sits in lands cleared from the forests overlooking the cataract through which the Miron river empties into Lake Laconis. The villagers grow rye and barley in fields misted by the spray from the falls.
desc_cn: 乔诺巴斯，或“黑树林”，坐落于由森林开辟出的一片土地上，俯瞰着弥戎河倾入拉科尼斯湖的大瀑布。村民们在瀑布旁水雾弥漫的田里种植黑麦与大麦。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S3_2}Skorin sits on a promontory separating Dyatom Bay from the wider Lake Laconis. Villagers pull both freshwater flatfish from the shallow bay waters and bigger catch, including pike, from the main lake.
desc_cn: 斯科林坐落于将佳托姆湾与拉科尼斯湖分割开的一个海角上。村民们在狭窄的海湾水域里捕捞淡水比目鱼，还在主湖区捕获梭鱼等更大的水产动物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S4_1}Borchovagorka sits on a small rise on the steep northern shores of Lake Laconis. The village depends primarily on fishing, pulling perch, bream, salmon and occasionally large sturgeon and pike from the lake waters.
desc_cn: 博乔瓦戈卡坐落于拉科尼斯湖陡峭北岸的一个小高处。这座村子以捕鱼为生，从湖水中捕捞鲈鱼、鲷鱼、鲑鱼，偶尔也捕捞大鲟鱼和梭鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S4_3}Omkany lies where the Lake Laconis coastline rises up to meet the icy Chertyg mountains. Villagers in this district raise hogs, curing their fat with salt and in garlic and selling it throughout the northlands.
desc_cn: 奥姆卡尼坐落于拉科尼斯湖畔与冰雪覆盖的车尔特格山脉之间。该地区的村民们饲养猪，并用盐和蒜腌制猪肥肉，销往北地各处。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S4_4}Yangutum sits in a nook of the Chertyg mountains on the north shores of Lake Laconis. The foresters harvest oak, elm and other hardwoods from the mountainsides.
desc_cn: 扬古图姆位于拉科尼斯湖北岸车尔特格山脉的一处角落。林务员们从山腰砍伐橡树、榆树和其他硬木。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S5_1}Visibrot is a sheep-rearing village on the lower slopes of Mount Iltan, just below the network of glacial lakes known as the Iltan portages. Though this region is cold and remote, its importance as a trade juncture between Lakes Laconis and Tanaesis, between the Empire and the steppe, mean that it is relatively densely populated.
desc_cn: 维西布罗特是伊勒坦山缓坡上的一座养羊村，正好位于人称伊勒坦运输线的冰湖网络下。尽管该地区寒冷偏僻，但它作为拉科尼斯湖与塔奈西斯湖之间，帝国和草原之间贸易节点的重要性，仍使其拥有了相对稠密的人口。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S5_2}Bukits sits on the eastern slopes of Mount Iltan on the Khuzait frontier. Villagers raise highland cattle here, bred to withstand the icy gusts that tear down the mountain.
desc_cn: 布基茨坐落于库赛特边境上伊勒坦山的东坡。这里的村民饲养一种高原牛，该品种可以抵御从山上吹来的刺骨寒风。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S6_1}The villagers of Kvol raise small, sturdy cattle at the base of the Chertyg mountains. They include the descendants of refugees and malcontents from across Calradia, seeking isolation in the cold northern forests.
desc_cn: 克沃尔的村民们会在车尔特格山脚下放牧一些好养活的小型牛。这些人当中有来自卡拉迪亚各地的难民与失意者的后代，他们在这寒气凛冽的北方森林中过着隐居避世的生活。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S6_2}Radakmed sits in a basin amid the Chertyg mountains. The rugged wilderness here abounds in fur-bearing game such as fox, marten and rabbit.
desc_cn: 拉达克梅德坐落于车尔特格山脉中的一片盆地。当地崎岖的荒野盛产狐狸、貂和兔子等毛皮动物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S6_3}Alebat sits deep in the forests of northeastern Sturgia. This isolated region has long been a refuge for those fleeing oppression or debt or bloodfeud across the northlands, and the dialect is strongly influenced by the tongue of the Vanni woodspeople.
desc_cn: 阿莱巴特坐落于斯特吉亚东北部的森林深处。这片偏远之地长久以来都是北方各地逃离压迫、债务和世仇之人的避难所，当地口音受森林民族瓦尼人的影响非常大。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S7_1}Korsyas sits near the narrowest part of the Bay of Varcheg. Villagers fish the waters to the west for cod, char, and other cold-water sea fish that venture into the bay.
desc_cn: 科尔夏斯位于瓦尔切格湾最狭窄处旁。村民们出海向西，捕捞鳕鱼、鲑鱼和其他冒险进入海湾的冷水鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_S7_2}Karbur sits at a plateau on the Kachyar peninsula. Sheltered somewhat by a high ridge to their north, the villagers here raise barley and grain.
desc_cn: 卡布尔坐落于卡恰尔半岛的高原之上，多少受到了北边高耸山脊的一些庇护。当地村民们种植大麦和谷物。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V1_1}Calioc on a flat plain between the Epiric and Biscan hills of the central Vlandian lands. The people of this district grow flax on the marshy lands.
desc_cn: 卡利奥克坐落于瓦兰迪亚中部埃皮尔山丘和比斯坎山之间的平原上，这里的人们在沼泽地上种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V1_2}Etirfurd sits near the Battanian frontier on a low spur just west of where the Etir river comes bursting out of a spring in the cliffs of the Uchalion massif. The villagers here grow wheat, finding a ready market in the garrisons stationed nearby.
desc_cn: 埃蒂尔菲德位于巴旦尼亚边界的一个低矮山嘴附近，埃蒂尔河从乌卡利翁地块山崖上的泉水中喷涌而出。当地村民种植小麦，并卖给驻扎在附近的军队。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V2_1}Mareiven sits on the steep wooded slopes of the Rhennod mountains, overlooking the Ocspool. Villagers harvest the tall trees of the heights, selling the logs to cities on the coast.
desc_cn: 马雷汶坐落于莱恩诺山脉密林覆盖的陡坡之上，俯视着整个奥克斯湖。村民们采伐高大的树木，然后卖到沿海的城市。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V2_2}Oritan sits on a short river that rushes out of the mountains of the Ebor peninsula and empties into the Ocspool. The river slows as it hits a nearby bend, allowing the collection of potters' clay from the banks.
desc_cn: 一条小河发源于埃博半岛的群山之中，最终汇入奥克斯湖，奥里唐就位于小河旁。水流速度到附近的一个拐角处变缓了，这样村民就可以从河岸掘取陶工所需要的黏土。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V2_3}Fregian sits on the flatlands north of Pravend, where the warmth of the Vlandian south begins to give way to the chills of the north. Villagers plant flax here amid the bogs and pastures.
desc_cn: 弗雷吉昂坐落于帕拉汶德北部的平原上，由此开始，瓦兰迪亚的南国暖流让位于北境的寒气。当地村民在沼泽和草地里种植亚麻。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V3_2}Rulund sits in the forested middle valleys of the Trand. The villagers specialize in the raising of hogs, who feast on acorns from the oak woodlands.
desc_cn: 鲁兰德位于特朗中部的林谷中。村民们以橡树林地的橡子为饲料来饲养生猪。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V3_3}Larnac sits on gentle hills on the lower Trand valley. Villagers plant rye, barley and wheat for sale to the hungry urban population of nearby Pravend.
desc_cn: 拉尔纳克坐落于特朗河谷下游的平缓山丘上。村民们种植黑麦、大麦和小麦，出售给帕拉汶德附近饥饿的城镇居民。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V3_4}Palisont sits at the mouth of a rocky glen that splits the grassy downs north of the Trand river. The soil is thin in these parts, but the cool sea air that flows upriver and the warm afternoons allow the growing of wine grapes.
desc_cn: 特朗河北部草绿色的丘陵被一道峻峭的峡谷分割开来，帕利松就坐落于峡谷口处。这一带土壤贫瘠，但从上游吹来的凉爽海风和温暖的午后气候，为酿酒用葡萄的生长提供了良好的条件。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V5_1}Furbec sits on a shelf overlooking the rocky Biscan coast of central Vlandia. The climate is warm most of the year, and grapes do well on the slopes of the Biscan hills.
desc_cn: 菲尔贝克坐落于一块巨岩上，俯瞰着瓦兰迪亚中部嶙峋的比斯坎海岸。当地全年气候温暖，比斯坎山坡上的葡萄长势喜人。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V5_2}Meroc is a fishing village overlooking a cove in the Biscan Coast. The villagers sail out into the western ocean in search of mullet and bass near the shore, and tuna and sardines amid the islands to the south.
desc_cn: 梅罗克是一座小渔村，能够俯瞰比斯坎海岸上的小海湾。村民们航行到西边的海域寻找靠近海岸的鲻鱼和鲈鱼，并在南边的岛屿附近寻找金枪鱼和沙丁鱼。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V5_3}Nogrent sits on a slope of the Biscan hills in central Vlandia. Villagers here raise sheep on the pastures between the coastal woods and the high crags of the hills.
desc_cn: 诺格伦坐落于瓦兰迪亚中部比斯坎丘陵的一处斜坡上。当地村民在沿海树林和高山峭壁之间的牧场上放羊。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V6_1}Arromanc lies in the Neurval, a valley that runs between the Biscan and Epiric hills. The warm lands of the Vlandian south are well-suited to the growing of olives.
desc_cn: 阿罗曼克坐落于穿过比斯坎山脉与埃皮尔山脉的纳尔谷。这片瓦兰迪亚南部的温暖土地非常适合种植橄榄。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V6_2}Mot lies in the Neurval, a valley that runs between the Biscan and Epiric hills. The warm lands of the Vlandian south are well-suited to the growing of olives.
desc_cn: 莫特坐落于穿过比斯坎山脉与埃皮尔山脉的纳尔谷。这片瓦兰迪亚南部的温暖土地非常适合种植橄榄。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V6_3}Alorstan sits on a shelf overlooking the sea, at the foot of the Biscan Hills. The warm south of the Vlandian lands is well-suited to the cultivation of olives.
desc_cn: 阿洛斯唐坐落于比斯坎山脚下一块可以俯瞰海洋的巨岩上。这片瓦兰迪亚南部的温暖土地非常适合种植橄榄。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V6_4}Chornad sits overlooking a pass through the Biscan hills. The villagers of this region, like many in the central Vlandian kingdom, specializing in the raising of pigs.
desc_cn: 绍尔纳坐瞰着经过比斯坎山的通路。当地村民和瓦兰迪亚王国中部的许多居民一样，专门从事养猪业。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V7_1}Savinth sits on warm, grassy plains north of the Bay of Charas. The land is fine pasture for the renowned horses of the Vlandians.
desc_cn: 萨万特坐落于沙拉斯湾以北温暖的草原上。这片土地是瓦兰迪亚人公认的优质马场。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V7_2}The village of Vesin lies by a creek running down from the Epiric Hills to the Bay of Charas. This warm land is well-suited to the growing of olive trees.
desc_cn: 韦桑村位于沙拉斯湾的埃皮尔山丘流下来的小溪旁，这片温暖的土地很适合橄榄树的生长。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V8_1}Horsger is where, according to legend, the warrior Horsa came ashore and planted his spear in the beach. Today it is known for its horses, who graze in rocky coastal slopes flecked with primrose and daffodils.
desc_cn: 传说中战士奥尔萨就是在奥尔斯热登陆，并将长矛插在了海滩上。如今，该地以马匹闻名，马儿们在点缀着报春花和水仙花的岩石海岸斜坡上吃草。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V8_2}Cananc lies in the wet wooded hills of the northern Rhennod, where cedars grow tall in the sea-mists. The village is known for producing fine pigs, who are allowed to range through the thick woods rooting for acorns, chestnuts and grubs.
desc_cn: 卡南克位于莱恩诺北部潮湿的林丘中，这个村庄以饲养优质猪而闻名，这些猪能在茂密的森林中穿梭，寻找橡子、栗子和蛴螬。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V8_3}Remental sits in a gap in the mountains of the Ebor peninsula. Towering fir and spruce grow on the slopes. Villagers trap fur-bearing animals like marten, rabbit and fox. This wild region has recently attracted many settlers drawn to the relative freedom of the woods, where the rule of the Vlandian barons is much lighter than in the south.
desc_cn: 勒芒塔尔在埃伯半岛的群山之中，陡坡上长满了直耸的云杉和冷杉。村民们用陷阱诱捕毛皮兽，如貂、兔子和狐狸。这片荒芜之地近来吸引了许多新的定居者，他们为森林的相对自由而来，瓦兰迪亚贵族在该地的统治也比南方宽松不少。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V9_1}Alantas sits in the center of the mountainous Ebor peninsula. The soil here is thin and the weather here is cold, but rich iron deposits sustain the local economy.
desc_cn: 阿兰塔斯坐落于多山的伊博半岛中央。这里土壤贫瘠、气候寒冷，但丰富的铁矿资源支撑起了本地经济。

desc_en: {=Settlements.Settlement.text.village_V9_2}Halisvust was once a marshy wasteland, but Vlandian settlers drained the waters and sowed wheat and rye in the valley.
desc_cn: 阿利斯维斯特曾是一片荒芜的沼泽，但瓦兰迪亚定居者们将水排干，在山谷中种起了小麦和黑麦。
